jobs.title: License Compliance Sales
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #
26WD100981
Position Overview
Autodesk is a global leader in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software, helping customers across the Manufacturing, Architecture, Engineering, Construction, and Media and Entertainment industries design, visualize, and simulate their ideas before bringing them to life.
As a License Compliance Inside Sales Representative, you will manage a high volume of License Compliance leads and opportunities, from qualification through commercial resolution. You will collaborate closely with Autodesk Sales teams, Channel Partners, Legal, and other members of the License Compliance team to address software licensing compliance matters.
In this role, you will engage directly with customers and users to investigate potential licensing violations, explain compliance requirements, and negotiate appropriate commercial resolutions. You will manage customer compliance engagements, including warning letters and audit activities, while maintaining positive customer relationships and supporting revenue recovery.
You will also be responsible for achieving and forecasting quarterly and annual License Compliance sales targets within your assigned territory.
Responsibilities
Manage a high volume of License Compliance leads and opportunities, engaging customers to identify software licensing violations and negotiate appropriate commercial resolutions
Communicate directly with customers to explain intellectual property or contractual licensing violations and agree on settlement values, purchasing requirements, and resolution timelines
Initiate warning letters and audit requests, guide customers through the compliance audit process, present findings, and negotiate commercial resolutions
Use Autodesk License Compliance analytics tools and databases to investigate and qualify potential compliance opportunities
Engage with C-suite executives, including Chief Executive Officers and other senior decision-makers, to secure cooperation and participation in compliance engagements
Communicate sensitive compliance findings professionally and manage challenging customer discussions and negotiations
Apply critical thinking and sound judgment to interpret Autodesk licensing rules and evaluate customer software deployments
Address complex customer objections and concerns while working toward appropriate compliance resolutions
Use Salesforce Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools to track leads, opportunities, customer activities, and outcomes in accordance with global License Compliance guidelines
Maintain accurate sales forecasts using lead tracking tools, customer self-audit documentation, targeted account selling methodologies, negotiation techniques, and established forecasting guidelines
Assist Value-Added Resellers (VARs) in preparing customer quotations, proposals, order forms, and product information to support compliance-related purchases
Collaborate with Territory Sales teams to identify appropriate cross-selling and upselling opportunities
Maintain working knowledge of Autodesk products, competitive offerings, industry trends, and customer project delivery methods
Proactively build collaborative relationships with Territory Sales teams to develop alternative commercial proposals that resolve customer compliance matters
Drive compliance opportunities through commercial closure while maintaining accurate pipeline visibility and supporting quarterly and annual sales objectives
Minimum Qualifications
8+ years of sales experience, preferably in customer-facing or enterprise software sales roles
Experience communicating and negotiating with executive-level stakeholders within the Small and Medium-Sized Enterprise (SME) segment
Strong written and verbal communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
Professional proficiency in English, with the ability to conduct business discussions and negotiations
Understanding of software licensing models, license agreements, and commercial contracts
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
Experience using Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools such as Salesforce or Siebel
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to evaluate complex customer situations and recommend appropriate solutions
Ability to manage multiple customer engagements, sales opportunities, and competing priorities effectively
Preferred Qualifications
Previous experience in License Compliance, software sales, Inside Sales, or related commercial roles
Knowledge of software compliance processes, audit procedures, and relevant legal frameworks
Knowledge of Information Technology (IT) concepts and enterprise software environments
Proficiency in the local language relevant to the assigned territory
Experience negotiating commercial agreements with senior executives and business decision-makers
Familiarity with software licensing audits, intellectual property protection, and compliance resolution processes
Experience collaborating with Channel Partners, Value-Added Resellers, and Territory Sales teams
Experience using sales forecasting tools, pipeline management processes, and structured negotiation methodologies
The Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate is an experienced and commercially focused sales professional who combines strong negotiation skills, analytical thinking, and customer relationship management expertise to resolve complex software licensing matters while delivering positive customer and business outcomes
Demonstrates strong commercial acumen and a thorough understanding of software licensing principles, customer engagement strategies, and sales processes
Builds trusted relationships with customers, senior executives, Channel Partners, and internal stakeholders
Communicates sensitive compliance matters clearly and professionally while maintaining constructive customer relationships
Applies analytical thinking, sound judgment, and data-driven insights to evaluate complex licensing situations and recommend effective solutions
Demonstrates confidence and resilience when handling challenging customer conversations, objections, and negotiations
Takes ownership of assigned License Compliance opportunities from initial investigation through successful commercial resolution
Balances Autodesk's intellectual property protection objectives with appropriate customer-focused commercial solutions
Uses strong negotiation and relationship management skills to influence stakeholders and achieve mutually acceptable outcomes
Collaborates effectively with Sales, Legal, Channel Partners, and cross-functional teams to resolve compliance matters
Maintains accurate pipeline records, forecasts, and customer engagement documentation
Demonstrates accountability, integrity, and professionalism when managing sensitive customer and contractual matters
Continuously develops knowledge of Autodesk products, licensing models, industry trends, and sales best practices
Thrives in a fast-paced, target-driven environment while maintaining a strong focus on customer experience and business results
#LI-NB1

26WD100041
Position Overview
Autodesk is seeking an experienced Principal Network Security Engineer to lead the design, architecture, and maturity of our global network security infrastructure and its security posture. In this role, you'll set the strategic direction for network security, drive improvements across our cloud and hybrid networks, implement foundation controls and partner with key stakeholders in our Enterprise IT organization to deliver Trust outcomes.
Responsibilities
Design, architect, and plan strategy for deployment of Security technologies in a complex and distributed network infrastructure to mitigate risks
Design, implement and manage scalable security controls on network security for Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), SASE, Intrusion Detection Systems, and auditing tools in both public and private cloud infrastructures
Design, implement and manage scalable security controls for web application firewalling, bot protection, content redirection and manipulation in a hybrid public/private cloud
Manage Security policies, standards and reviews of network segmentation and other cloud-based network services
Develop and implement security protocols and procedures to prevent and mitigate potential threats in a cloud environment
Support with responding to security breaches promptly, conduct thorough investigations, and propose long-term solutions at a network level
Provide technical leadership and guidance in cloud network security matters
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure network security aligns with business objectives
Work closely with all Trust stakeholders for alignment on design and strategy
Develop automations to improve operational efficiency
Support compliance and regular security audits, generate reports for evidence, and provide recommendations for improvements
Stay abreast of the latest security trends, threats, and mitigation techniques

At least 8 years of network security experience, with a strong emphasis on cloud environments
Expertise in cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud and Security capabilities offered by these platforms
Knowledge of routing, load balancing and edge or perimeter network capabilities in cloud environments
Proven experience with security technologies (firewalls, intrusion detection systems, SASE, NAC, WAF, DDoS protection etc.)
Deep understanding and experience with DNS, NTP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VPN, SD-WAN, and other critical protocols
Network monitoring and analytics tools (NetFlow, sFlow, packet analysis)
AI/ML-powered network security — covering anomaly detection, threat prediction, automated remediation, and intelligent analytics

Strong knowledge of cybersecurity principles and best practices

jobs.title: Senior Sales Specialist, Fusion – South India
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #
26WD98170
Senior Sales Specialist, Fusion – South India
Location: Bangalore
Position Overview
Fusion is one of Autodesk’s fastest-growing businesses, and we’re targeting a new class of high-potential manufacturing accounts across South India — companies that may not yet be major Autodesk customers but have significant upside for Fusion adoption. We’re hiring a Senior Sales Specialist, Fusion Territory – South India to break into these accounts, build demand, and close meaningful Fusion business. This is a full-cycle, entrepreneurial sales role.
You will be assigned target customers across South India selected based on their potential for Fusion adoption. Some may already be using Fusion in limited ways, while many will be completely new customers. In every case, you will own the entire process — from prospecting and discovery to proposal development, negotiation, and closing.
Success in this territory requires an understanding of South India’s diverse business environments, regional languages, and local business practices. You will build trusted relationships with customers and partners by adapting your communication and engagement approach to their language preferences, business context, and decision-making processes.
This role is about building Fusion’s presence across South India from the ground up.
Autodesk’s culture emphasizes curiosity, rapid innovation, and ownership. We believe in “reimagining what is possible,” taking smart risks, and pursuing results with urgency. Within Fusion, we live that. You’ll be joining a team that combines the agility of a startup, the backing of a global leader, and a passion for meaningful change in manufacturing. If you’re a hunter who thrives on opening new doors, engaging new logos, and owning the full process, this is an exciting opportunity to make an outsized impact.
Responsibilities
Break into large, high-potential target accounts across South India and ignite new Fusion conversations where Autodesk currently has limited presence
Own the full sales cycle: prospecting, qualification, discovery, scoping, solution alignment, negotiation, and close
Capture first wins in new customers and expand them into broader Fusion opportunities
Identify priority divisions, teams, or workflows inside large enterprises where Fusion can deliver immediate value
Conduct on-site meetings across the territory, build credibility, and earn trust with engineering, manufacturing, and operations teams
Adapt customer engagement to regional language preferences and local business practices, using English and relevant regional languages to support discovery, relationship building, and commercial discussions
Lead value-driven dialogues about how Fusion’s cloud-native, AI-enabled platform empowers design, engineering, and manufacturing workflows
Collaborate with technical sales, local and regional partners, product specialists, and marketing to accelerate adoption and expansion
Maintain a high-velocity pipeline, accurate forecasting, and disciplined opportunity hygiene within Salesforce
Deploy modern sales tools such as Salesforce and Outreach, to optimize engagement and performance
Capture regional customer insights and document repeatable plays that help scale Fusion adoption across emerging accounts
How You Will Be Measured
New Fusion revenue generated within your assigned high-potential accounts across South India
Successful activation of net-new Fusion customers and expansion of existing ones
Pipeline creation, deal progression, and forecast accuracy
Minimum Qualifications
Proven track record in full-cycle software sales, especially in new-logo or territory expansion roles
Experience engaging customers in South India, with a demonstrated understanding of regional business practices, buying processes, and relationship building
Professional proficiency in English and the ability to conduct customer-facing business discussions in at least one relevant South Indian language, such as Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, or Malayalam. Proficiency in additional regional languages is an advantage
Ability to build trust with customers and partners across diverse linguistic and cultural backgrounds and adapt communication to different stakeholders
Ability to open doors, qualify opportunities, and convert cold accounts into an engaged pipeline
Strong discovery skills and value-selling experience with technical or manufacturing audiences
Confidence independently owning and managing deals end-to-end without reliance on an existing account owner
Ability to identify the right entry points inside complex organizations and land initial successes that expand
Willingness and ability to travel across South India for customer meetings, partner engagement, and business development
Passion for cloud, AI, digital transformation, and modern manufacturing technology
An agile mindset, entrepreneurial spirit, and a drive to scale a high-impact product in a competitive market

jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #
26WD101359
Position Overview
The Customer Success Manager plays a pivotal role in driving the success of our largest regional customers - primarily in the AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction, and Owner) industry in Singapore - by overseeing how they are onboarded with Autodesk solutions, adopt them effectively, and expand their use to achieve impactful business outcomes. Given the growing demand from our valued customers headquartered in Singapore, this is an additional headcount we have based in the region.
In this senior role, you will manage your own portfolio of 10-15 of the largest regional customers within the AECO industry, working directly with them to co-create and execute a tailored Customer Success Plan that ensures they derive measurable business value from their partnership with Autodesk and our Channel Partners. Your customers will have clear business justifications to nurture and grow their investment in the Autodesk partnership.
Additionally, you will leverage data-driven insights to enable proactive engagement with customers, addressing potential risks such as low product adoption or customer churn.
You will collaborate with Autodesk Sales, Customer Success, Renewals, Marketing, and Channel Partner teams to ensure the success of an assigned set of regional customers.
You will report to the Senior Manager, Customer Success - APAC Emerging Markets and have team members across India, ASEAN, and China. You will also be part of the broader APJ Customer Success Organisation with Customer Success Managers also in Australia, Japan, and Korea.
Autodesk offers a flexible working environment, with this role based in Singapore.
Responsibilities
Co-create and execute a tailored Customer Success Plan with assigned AECO customers, aligning on their mission-critical priorities, key initiatives, and adoption plans for Autodesk solutions, while driving specific actions to ensure success, aimed at helping customers achieve their desired business outcomes
Act as the owner and orchestrator of Customer Success planning and execution, holding customers, Autodesk teams, and Channel Partners accountable for agreed actions
Co-document the tangible business value each customer is achieving through Autodesk solutions, capturing these as success stories to demonstrate measurable outcomes and success
Support customers during onboarding of new solutions, identifying and assisting at-risk customers with low product adoption to help them fully utilise the products and services they have invested in, reducing churn risk
Partner with Autodesk Sales, Customer Success, Technical Sales, Renewals, and Channel Partners to drive coordinated adoption motions
Participate in regular Account Planning processes with Sales, Technical Sales, and Renewal teams, identifying targeted accounts to drive success planning activities, engagement strategies, and alignment on business outcomes
Monitor customer usage data and other health indicators and translate these insights into strategies for success, in collaboration with reseller partners and internal Autodesk teams
Engage confidently with stakeholders across customer organisations, including C-level decision-makers, mid-management, business unit leaders, contract managers, and key champion users
Identify opportunities with Customer Success Managers in other countries for meaningful peer-to-peer connections with others in the industry, across other countries, and in the global market through the Autodesk ecosystem and events

Experience or familiarity in the AECO industry (Architecture, Engineering, Construction, or Owner/Operator organisations)

Demonstrated ability to understand and uncover customer business challenges and align solutions to business outcomes
Experience working for or servicing large organisations with complex stakeholder environments
Excellent executive and business-level communication skills
Strong customer empathy and a customer-first mindset
Ability to prioritise multiple complex tasks in a fast-paced environment
Ability to collaborate and coordinate across multiple internal and external stakeholders

Familiarity with, or experience as a current or former user of, Autodesk AECO solutions such as Autodesk Forma (formerly known as Autodesk Construction Cloud), Revit, Civil 3D, Navisworks, or competitor technologies.

Autodesk is seeking an accomplished Senior Principal Applications Engineer to provide technical leadership and architectural vision across strategic initiatives within the Growth Experience Technology (GET) organization. This role is responsible for shaping the long-term technology strategy, driving architectural excellence, and influencing the design and delivery of scalable platforms and integrations that enable Customer Success teams to drive customer adoption, engagement, retention, and business outcomes at scale.
As a senior technical leader, you will partner closely with Engineering, Product Management, Architecture, and executive stakeholders to define technical roadmaps, solve complex business and engineering challenges, and ensure the successful execution of critical initiatives. You will lead the design of highly available, secure, and scalable distributed systems, establish engineering standards and best practices, and mentor engineers across multiple teams.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on technologist with deep expertise in modern cloud-native architectures, platform engineering, AI-assisted development, and enterprise integrations. You are passionate about innovation, thrive in ambiguous environments, and have a proven track record of influencing technical direction across organizations. You combine strategic thinking with execution excellence and are motivated by delivering measurable customer and business impact through technology.
Responsibilities
Own the technical vision and architecture for multiple enterprise platforms and services, including CRM ecosystems, translating product strategy and OKRs into measurable technical roadmaps
Lead the design and delivery of highly available, secure, and scalable production systems, including microservices, enterprise APIs, Salesforce CRM solutions, integration services, orchestration platforms, and modern web applications
Define the enterprise architecture for all integrations, ensuring seamless connectivity with internal and external business systems through REST APIs, middleware, event-driven architectures, and integration platform.
Drive cross-organizational architectural decisions on application design, integration patterns, API standards, tooling, and engineering frameworks to promote consistency, reuse, scalability, and governance across engineering teams
Produce and review production-quality code, architecture documents, technical design specifications, runbooks, and lead major migrations, cutovers, platform modernization initiatives, and enterprise transformation programs
Define and enforce engineering standards for CI/CD, automated testing, observability, SLOs/SLIs, security, governance, cost optimization, resiliency, and autoscaling across cloud-native platforms
Champion comprehensive automated testing strategies, including unit, integration, contract, regression, performance, and load testing, while enabling continuous integration and continuous delivery
Own operational readiness and platform reliability in partnership with SRE teams, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, disaster recovery, backup and restore, production support, and capacity planning
Partner closely with Product Management, Enterprise Architects, Engineering Managers, Business Systems, and cross-functional stakeholders to prioritize technical initiatives, manage dependencies, and align engineering investments with business outcomes
Provide technical leadership for enterprise CRM strategy, Salesforce platform evolution, and large-scale enterprise integration initiatives, ensuring scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions
Mentor Principal Engineers, Senior Engineers, and Engineering Managers through architecture reviews, technical coaching, and engineering best practices while cultivating technical leadership across the organization
Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies, including AI/ML, GenAI, workflow orchestration, event streaming, and modern integration platforms, proactively identifying technical debt, architectural risks, and opportunities for continuous improvement

14+ years of software development experience with demonstrated expertise across the full product development lifecycle
Strong knowledge of Salesforce architecture, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Platform, APIs, integration patterns, data modeling, security, and identity management.
Proven experience designing scalable, secure, highly available, and maintainable Salesforce solutions for complex enterprise environments.
Strong understanding of Salesforce development and configuration capabilities, including Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow, SOQL, and platform security.
Knowledge of enterprise integration patterns and technologies, including REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven architectures, middleware, and external systems integration.
Proven ability to lead key business outcomes and initiatives, with accountability for results that impact the division or functional area
Strong experience designing and evolving SDKs, APIs, and platform capabilities consumed by multiple teams and connector integrations
Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction and achieve alignment across teams and divisions without direct authority
Strong understanding of build automation, CI/CD pipelines, and developer experience optimization
Ability to clearly articulate the business drivers for an area of technical investment
Preferred Qualifications
Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise applications including ERP, Customer Success platforms (e.g., Gainsight), data warehouses, marketing automation, identity providers, and third-party SaaS applications
Knowledge of AWS cloud services, including EC2, S3, IAM, RDS, Lambda, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, and EKS, with an understanding of designing resilient, secure, highly available architectures.
Experience designing event-driven architectures using event buses, asynchronous messaging, and distributed workflows
Experience leading large-scale cloud modernization, digital transformation, or enterprise platform migration initiatives
Experience building AI-powered enterprise applications using GenAI technologies, LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, AI agents, or Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Experience designing secure, compliant enterprise platforms with knowledge of OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, Zero Trust architecture, PCI, SOC 2, GDPR, or similar security and compliance frameworks
Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders, drive technology strategy across multiple engineering organizations, and build consensus on long-term architectural direction

jobs.title: Consulting Principal, Solutions Engineering Lead
jobs.description:
About Cognizant Consulting
Cognizant Consulting is more than Cognizant’s consulting practice. We’re a global community of 5,000+ experts dedicated to helping clients reimagine their business. Blending our deep industry and technology advisory capability, we create innovative business solutions for Fortune 500 clients. And now, we’re looking for our next colleague who’ll join us in shaping the future of business. Could it be you?
About the role
As a Consulting Principal, Solutions Engineering Lead, you will make an impact by designing and delivering enterprise-scale AWS cloud solutions that enable complex application migration, modernization, and platform transformation.
You will be a valued member of the Solutions Engineering team and work collaboratively with AWS architects, Cognizant delivery leadership, and client engineering, platform, and product teams. This role combines hands-on technical delivery with consulting leadership, requiring you to own architectural outcomes while helping client engineering teams build sustainable cloud and DevSecOps capabilities.
In this role, you will:
Architect and deliver enterprise AWS cloud solutions aligned with AWS Well-Architected principles, including landing zones, multi-account architectures, networking, identity and access management, security, and platform engineering for complex financial-services workloads.
Lead cloud migration and application modernization initiatives, moving applications from on-premises and legacy cloud environments to AWS, with emphasis on ECS/Fargate, container-based services, serverless architectures, APIs, and cloud-native modernization patterns.
Design and build Infrastructure as Code using AWS CDK and TypeScript, including reusable L2/L3 constructs, stack composition, cross-account deployment patterns, AWS Organizations guardrails, and standardized ECS/Fargate service constructs.
Engineer secure DevSecOps and CI/CD capabilities, including pipeline design and standardization, automated security and quality gates, IAM policies, AWS Config, CloudTrail, Security Hub, CSPM tooling, and cloud compliance controls.
Serve as a trusted technical advisor to client teams, leading discovery sessions, architecture reviews, technical workshops, paired-programming sessions, and structured knowledge transfer to strengthen client capabilities across AWS, CDK/TypeScript, DevSecOps, ECS/Fargate, and cloud-native engineering.
Work model
We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.
What you must have to be considered
15+ years of hands-on cloud and infrastructure engineering experience, including 5+ years focused on AWS, with deep architecture expertise across VPC, IAM, EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, AWS Organizations, CloudFormation, and AWS CDK.
Strong hands-on AWS CDK and TypeScript expertise, including authoring L2/L3 constructs, stack composition, reusable IaC patterns, cross-account deployments, landing zones, and enterprise security guardrails.
Proven experience delivering enterprise cloud migration and application modernization, including rehosting, replatforming and modernization, with strong container expertise across Docker, ECS/Fargate, EKS, Kubernetes and Helm.
Strong CI/CD and DevSecOps engineering experience, including designing and standardizing pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI, combined with experience implementing IAM, cloud-security guardrails, CSPM, and automated compliance controls.
Demonstrated consulting and client-facing delivery experience, including architecture leadership, technical workshops, executive and engineering stakeholder communication, and structured knowledge transfer or coaching that builds sustainable client engineering capability.
These will help you succeed
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional and/or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional certification.
Experience with ECS and Fargate modernization, including task-definition patterns, service autoscaling, ECR integration, and Fargate Spot optimization.
Experience with AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) methodologies and cloud migration programs in financial services, banking, or other regulated industries.
Familiarity with Terraform, particularly translating or evolving Terraform-based infrastructure patterns into AWS CDK/TypeScript constructs, along with exposure to Azure or Google Cloud.
Experience with FinOps and cloud-cost governance, including tagging governance and reserved-capacity planning.
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

Salary: £33,000
Start date: September 2027
Location: Hatfield
Programme length: 12 months
Contract type: Permanent, full time
Application process: Online application, behavioural test, video interview and face to face interview
Looking to make a real impact from day one? Join Computacenter’s Group Information Services (GIS) function, a global team that partners with every part of the business to lead on technology and security. We’re all about delivering smart, world-class solutions that create real value and exceptional experiences for our customers.
Our Technology Strategy & Innovation team offers a unique opportunity to gain experience across business analysis, consulting, strategy and emerging technologies. Working with stakeholders across Computacenter and as part of a global team, you’ll contribute to projects that help shape future technology solutions while developing a broad understanding of how technology supports business success.
If you’re curious, collaborative and passionate about technology, you’ll have the opportunity to work on meaningful projects, learn from experienced professionals and help drive innovation across the organisation.
What you’ll do
As part of the Technology Strategy & Innovation team, you’ll support a range of activities across business analysis, innovation and technology consulting, including:
Working with stakeholders across the business to understand challenges and support technology initiatives
Gathering, analysing and presenting information to support business and technology projects
Researching emerging technologies, industry trends and future opportunities
Exploring new technologies and helping to build prototypes that demonstrate potential applications
Coordinating project activities and maintaining team resources, templates, data and knowledge repositories
Supporting innovation activities including workshops, idea generation and exploring new technologies
Collaborating with colleagues across Technology Consulting, Business Analysis and wider GIS teams
As part of the programme, you’ll follow a structured development plan and have the opportunity to build your professional network and develop specialist interests within Technology Strategy & Innovation.
You’ll also become part of a collaborative graduate community within the GIS function, benefiting from peer support, networking opportunities, and shared learning experiences that enrich your journey and help you build lasting connections across the organisation.
What you’ll need
You are degree educated (any subject and any classification accepted)
You’re curious about how technology shapes business
You’re confident building relationships and communicating with others
You’ll have the ability to manage multiple priorities and work proactively
You enjoy solving problems and finding smarter ways of working
You’ll need to be comfortable researching and presenting insights on emerging topics
You’ll need to be organised and confident in managing tasks and documentation
You are free from September 2027 to start the 12-month graduate programme.
About us
We are a leading independent technology and services provider, trusted by large corporate and public sector organisations. We are a responsible business that believes in winning together for our people and our planet. We help our customers to source, transform and manage their technology infrastructure to deliver digital transformation, enabling people and their business.
We’re a place where you can belong
With over 21,000 people across 22 countries, we are proud of our inclusive culture - where everyone can thrive, feel valued, and truly belong.
You’ll see this reflected in our recruitment process too. We aim to provide fair access to opportunities and an inclusive, barrier‑free experience. All that matters to us is that you share our vision and values, and bring the skills and experience we need.
As a Disability Confident Committed employer, we offer a guaranteed interview scheme. If you opt in and meet the minimum criteria for the role, you’ll be guaranteed an interview, and we’re happy to support any reasonable adjustments. Please let us know when you apply.
If you share our values and want to make a meaningful impact in a supportive, forward-thinking environment - we’d love to hear from you!

Life on the team
Salary Package: Earn up to £35,000 OTE (On-Target Earnings) through a combination of base salary and performance-related bonus opportunities during the programme.
Start Date: September 2027
Location: London or Hatfield
Programme Duration: 16 months
Contract Type: Permanent – Full Time
Start your career in technology sales with excellent earning potential, global exposure and the support to grow from day one. You'll be actively developing your skills, expanding your commercial knowledge and preparing for future customer engagement through hands-on learning, mentoring and real business exposure.
Our sales teams play a key role in helping some of the world’s leading organisations use technology to solve business challenges, improve how they work and achieve their goals. As part of the team, you’ll help customers source, transform and manage their technology infrastructure, while building the skills, confidence and commercial understanding to grow a successful career in sales.
Our 16-month Technology Sales Graduate Programme starts in September 2027 and gives you a structured development journey, access to high-quality training and the opportunity to accelerate your career in a fast-moving technology sales environment.
You’ll work alongside other Associates across the UK, Europe and the USA, learning how the full sales cycle works and developing the sales skills, business knowledge and confidence needed to build long-term relationships with our customers.
You’ll be part of a commercially driven culture shaped by our Winning Together values, where you’ll be coached and supported by experienced people across the business. Along the way, you’ll build your network across Computacenter and the wider technology industry, gain exposure to leading technology partners and develop a clear understanding of how we deliver value for our customers.
Many of our previous Associates have progressed into successful sales and leadership roles, so if you’re looking for a place where you can learn, grow and build a long-term career, this could be the opportunity for you.
What you’ll do
Spend time on rotations across different areas of the business to understand how Computacenter works and how we support our customers.
Build your knowledge of technology, products and solutions, and how they help customers achieve their business goals.
Develop the core sales skills needed to become a confident, high-performing sales professional through practical sales activities, presentations, training and one-to-one coaching.
Gain hands-on experience creating customer-facing materials and learning the tools and processes that drive sales success. As you progress through the programme, you'll build towards supporting real customer opportunities, live sales campaigns and commercial conversations.
Take part in partner site visits and wider technology events with leading brands such as Apple, Microsoft and Dell, giving you exposure to the tech industry beyond the day-to-day role.

Work towards external, industry-recognised sales training and qualifications to support your long-term career in sales.

We believe the best learning happens through connection and experience. Real exposure to executive and senior leaders from across the business.

A dedicated support network, including a buddy, mentor and wider graduate community.

Partner with stakeholders across the business to develop innovative transport and packaging solutions that meet evolving customer needs.

Strong commercial and analytical skills, with the ability to turn data and market insight into practical action.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills across different countries, cultures and business areas.
A collaborative, resilient and results-focused approach, with strong attention to detail and governance.

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Procurement Specialist to join our fiber cable manufacturing team. This role demands expertise in sourcing a diverse range of components.
Strategic Sourcing & Cost Reduction:
Develop and execute sourcing strategies to achieve significant cost savings and total cost of ownership (TCO) improvements across assigned categories (polymers, molded plastics, mechanical components).
Conduct thorough market research and analysis to identify potential new suppliers, predict cost trends, and assess supply chain risks.
Lead renegotiations of existing vendor contracts and terms to ensure the best value and favorable pricing for the company.
Implement e-sourcing tools and data analysis techniques to optimize procurement processes and identify ongoing cost-saving opportunities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering, manufacturing, finance, and legal departments to align procurement activities with overall business objectives and production schedules.

Experience:
Proven experience as a Procurement Specialist or similar role within a manufacturing environment, preferably in the fiber optics or related industry.

Experience in managing contract manufacturing (CM) relationships and agreements.
Proven track record of successfully implementing cost reduction measures and achieving measurable savings.
Skills:
Exceptional negotiation communication, and interpersonal skills to build strong vendor relationships.
Proficiency in procurement software, ERP systems (e.g., SAP preferred), and Microsoft Office Suite (advanced Excel skills preferred).
Expertise in Power BI: Proficiency in using Microsoft Power BI for data visualization, spend analysis, and creating interactive dashboards to track KPIs and cost-saving initiatives would be a significant advantage. This skill will be highly valued for driving data-informed decisions within the procurement function.
Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
Strong analytical skills for data analysis, cost modeling, and forecasting.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build rapport with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
Education:
BE B.TECH – Mech/ Electrical/ Electronics/Instrumentation with Minimum of 10 years of experience in procurement, preferably in Telecom Industry.

Req ID:
82785
Location:
Claremont, North Carolina, United States
General Summary
The Building & Campus Americas Leader leads the regional business agenda and commercial execution across the United States, Canada, and CALA. This senior leader functions as the regional general manager for the Americas, with accountability for Sales, Systems Engineering, Regional Marketing, and Customer Service, and shared ownership of revenue growth, gross margin, market share, forecast accuracy, pricing execution, channel performance, demand creation, and customer experience.
The role leads the Americas Sales, Systems Engineering, Regional Marketing, and Customer Service organizations and establishes an integrated go-to-market and customer engagement model across direct sales, distribution, partners, consultants, contractors, integrators, strategic accounts, and other market influencers. The Americas Leader builds a disciplined regional operating cadence and partners with Product Line Management, Commercial Operations, Engineering, Operations, Finance, and other Building & Campus leaders to align growth priorities, portfolio needs, supply realities, pricing actions, investment choices, and customer commitments into one regional execution plan.
Duties & Responsibilities
• Define and execute the Americas commercial strategy for Building & Campus across the United States, Canada, and CALA, translating business priorities into regional, country, vertical, segment, account, and route-to-market plans.
• Own Americas revenue, gross margin, market share, bookings, pipeline, forecast, pricing execution, sales expense, operating efficiency, and regional investment performance, with clear accountability for corrective action when commitments are at risk.
• Lead regional and country sales leaders by establishing consistent accountability for territory design, account ownership, coverage, productivity, customer engagement, talent quality, leadership routines, and execution against annual sales plans.
• Optimize market coverage and differentiated go-to-market execution across direct sales, strategic accounts, distribution, channel partners, consultants, contractors, systems integrators, and other decision makers to position CommScope Building & Campus as a preferred solutions provider.
• Build executive relationships with key customers, channel partners, distributors, design influencers, and industry stakeholders; actively sponsor major opportunities, strategic bids, and critical customer escalations.
• Drive disciplined pipeline management, CRM adoption, opportunity quality, sales-stage governance, forecast accuracy, and weekly and monthly commercial reviews across the Americas organization, with clear expectations for variance explanation, recovery actions, deal inspection, risk escalation, and decision-making when plans are off track.
• Own the follow-through from regional commercial reviews, including documenting decisions, assigning owners, tracking commitments, escalating risks, and ensuring that corrective actions translate into measurable improvements in revenue, margin, forecast quality, pipeline health, pricing discipline, and customer outcomes.
• Lead regional pricing and discount execution in partnership with Product Line Management and Finance, balancing revenue growth, market competitiveness, price realization, and gross margin objectives.
• Partner with Product Line Management and Engineering to translate customer, competitor, application, pricing, channel, and market intelligence into portfolio priorities, product roadmaps, business cases, solution requirements, and region-specific actions that improve win rate, share position, and profitable growth.
• Lead the regional competitive response process by identifying share threats, pricing pressure, channel conflict, coverage gaps, product-positioning issues, and competitor moves, then coordinating timely actions with Product Line Management, Marketing, Finance, Channel, and Sales leadership.
• Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, and Customer Experience to align demand, backlog, product availability, service levels, and customer commitments with regional priorities.
• Strengthen distribution and partner coverage where needed, challenge underperforming routes to market, and establish clear partner expectations, segmentation, enablement, and performance management.
• Ensure appropriate field application and systems engineering support is aligned to regional opportunities and serves as an effective conduit between customers, sales, and product teams.
• Lead Customer Service to deliver responsive order management, issue resolution, communication, and service performance; establish clear service metrics and coordinate cross-functionally to address recurring customer pain points.
• Lead Regional Marketing to translate business priorities into differentiated regional campaigns, vertical and segment programs, partner marketing, sales enablement, launches, events, and demand-generation plans with measurable commercial outcomes.
• Develop annual operating plans, regional growth initiatives, resource plans, and investment priorities based on market attractiveness, customer potential, cost to serve, expected return, execution capacity, and the trade-offs required to deliver the region’s revenue and margin commitments.
• Build, develop, and retain a high-performing, diverse Americas sales leadership team with clear succession plans, leadership bench strength, role clarity, and accountability.
• Lead organizational change and commercial transformation across a complex matrix while establishing transparent communication, consistent processes, and alignment with Building & Campus priorities.
• Ensure compliance with applicable company policies, financial controls, channel governance, ethical standards, and commercial approval requirements.
• Represent the Americas region as a key member of the Building & Campus leadership team and contribute to long-range planning, portfolio reviews, investment priorities, and strategic decisions.
• Bring a regional profit-and-loss mindset to decision-making, using financial data, commercial analytics, and operating inputs to balance growth, margin, operating expense, customer commitments, and long-term share position.
Key Deliverables
• Americas commercial strategy and execution roadmap covering the United States, Canada, and CALA.
• Delivery of regional revenue, gross margin, market share, bookings, pipeline, forecast, and sales expense commitments.
• Improved sales coverage, channel productivity, CRM discipline, forecast accuracy, price realization, and commercial operating cadence.
• Stronger executive relationships and measurable growth across priority customers, verticals, partners, distributors, consultants, contractors, and integrators.
• A high-performing Americas sales organization with clear accountability, succession capability, and consistent execution.
• Integrated regional execution across Sales, Systems Engineering, Regional Marketing, and Customer Service, with measurable improvement in technical influence, demand generation, service performance, and customer experience.
Accountability / Impact
• Regional accountability for Building & Campus commercial performance across the United States, Canada, and CALA.
• Direct impact on revenue growth, gross margin, market share, customer retention, channel effectiveness, forecast quality, and business profitability.
• Responsible for leading leaders and influencing investment, pricing, portfolio, coverage, and resource decisions across a complex regional organization.
• Expected to provide executive-level leadership, commercial discipline, and strategic direction for the Building & Campus business in the Americas.
Required Qualifications for Consideration
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, or a related discipline.
• 15+ years of progressive sales, commercial, channel, business development, or related leadership experience in complex B2B markets.
• 10+ years of people leadership experience, including experience leading leaders and geographically dispersed teams.
• Demonstrated success owning regional revenue, gross margin, market share, forecast, and sales expense performance.
• Proven experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies across direct, distribution, partner, consultant, integrator, and strategic-account channels.
• Experience leading sales organizations in a global, matrixed environment and influencing Product Line Management, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Customer Experience, and other cross-functional teams.
• Strong financial and commercial acumen, including pricing, discount management, pipeline analytics, forecasting, resource allocation, operating expense discipline, investment prioritization, business-case development, and the ability to explain regional performance drivers to senior leadership.
• Strong executive communication, negotiation, customer engagement, organizational leadership, and change leadership skills.
• Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally as business needs require. Candidates located outside Claremont, North Carolina must reside within reasonable proximity to a major commercial airport.
• Demonstrated experience leading or integrating Sales with Systems Engineering, Regional Marketing, and Customer Service or comparable customer-facing functions.
Preferred Qualifications
• Master’s degree in Business Administration or a related discipline.
• Experience in cable, connectivity, telecommunications, data center infrastructure, electrical infrastructure, network infrastructure, or related technology markets.
• Knowledge of structured cabling, copper connectivity, fiber connectivity, partner ecosystems, distribution, consulting engineers, contractors, and systems integrators.
• Demonstrated success transforming a sales organization, improving forecast discipline, increasing channel productivity, and building leadership bench strength.
• Experience integrating customer, competitor, pricing, and market intelligence into regional growth plans and portfolio decisions.
• Experience leading commercial teams across the United States, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, and other CALA markets or a similarly diverse Americas region.
• The preferred location for this position is Claremont, North Carolina. Consideration may also be given to qualified candidates located elsewhere within the Americas, provided they reside within reasonable proximity to a major commercial airport and are able to meet the position’s domestic and international travel requirements.

The Fintech Platform Systems Engineering team builds and operates the AWS-based infrastructure, resiliency tooling, and incident response capability that underpins Intuit's money-movement and fintech services — where availability, data integrity, and trust are non-negotiable.

This is a player-coach role. You will set technical direction and organizational strategy while staying close to the systems — reviewing designs, joining incident bridges, and coaching engineers through complex production issues. You'll partner closely with software engineering, product, security, and other SRE/infrastructure leaders across Intuit to raise the bar on reliability company-wide.
A defining priority for this role is AI Ops: embedding AI-driven, autonomous operations into how the team runs infrastructure. You will lead the shift from manual, human-triggered response toward self-healing systems that detect, diagnose, and remediate issues autonomously — reducing developer toil, cutting MTTR, and freeing engineering capacity to focus on higher-value work. Done well, this delivers 3x the operational impact of the team today and directly accelerates the pace at which we deliver value to customers.

Responsibilities

The PDX group builds the foundational capabilities that developers across Intuit rely on to build and run flagship applications on cloud native infrastructure at scale. Intuit believes in open source, both as a consumer and a contributor, and our engineers participate actively in communities including CNCF, Istio, and Argo.
We're looking for a product leader who can own two connected platform domains: the systems that provision and run Intuit's cloud infrastructure, and the systems that make Intuit's APIs and services usable by AI agents, not just human developers. You'll set direction for how infrastructure gets provisioned against policy, and for how AI agents discover, integrate with, and operate Intuit's internal services with less and less human intervention over time.
This role carries senior staff scope. You'll set product strategy independently, make tradeoffs other teams will build against, and represent these platforms directly to engineering and executive stakeholders.
Responsibilities
Own the product strategy and roadmap for Intuit's infrastructure orchestration and provisioning platform, working closely with the engineering teams who build and operate it.
Own the product strategy and roadmap for Intuit's agent-readiness platform, which evaluates how usable Intuit's internal APIs and services are for AI agents and drives the work that closes the gaps.
Define the metrics that matter for each platform, from infrastructure reliability and provisioning speed to how much manual work it still takes before an agent can operate a given capability end to end, and use those metrics to prioritize the roadmap.
Partner with the teams that define platform policy, identity, access, lifecycle rules, so that what you build upholds that policy rather than duplicating or drifting from it.
Work with capability teams across Intuit to help them raise their agent-readiness scores, generate the integration assets they're missing, and turn what used to be manual, tribal-knowledge work into something an agent or a new engineer can follow directly.
Represent both platforms to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, with a clear narrative tying platform investment to developer productivity and to Intuit's broader AI strategy.
Build and run a scrum team based in India, setting the cadence, backlog discipline, and quality bar that let a distributed team ship independently.
Qualifications
10 or more years of product management experience, including platform, infrastructure, or developer-tools products.
Direct experience with AI-enabled products or platforms, with a strong enough technical foundation to work through integration and architecture tradeoffs with engineering.
Strong experience with AI Evals, model evaluations, technical use cases, shared platform capabilities, driving adoption and growth of platform capabilities, and leveraging AI to assess technical capabilities, and agentic PDLC.
A track record of owning a product end to end: setting strategy, defining success metrics, and driving a roadmap that a distributed engineering team executes against.
Comfort partnering across adjacent platform teams where ownership boundaries matter, and judgment about when to defer to another team's policy versus when to push back.
Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to both engineers and executives.
Experience managing or closely partnering with engineering teams based in India strongly preferred.

jobs.description:
Intuit's Global Business Solutions Group (GBSG) is scaling Money Services and Workforce Solutions at a pace the organization hasn't operated at before — GBSG revenue growth is driven in large part by growth in money and payroll offerings, and Intuit's recent acquisition of GoCo is bringing world-class HCM capabilities into the platform to power a single, full-employee-lifecycle solution. As Head of Workforce Solutions Service Delivery, you will own the end-to-end customer support experience for Intuit's Workforce Solutions customers, delivered through a multi-partner outsourced delivery network spanning multiple geographies, alongside an internal team of Intuit-badged workforce experts.
This is a foundational leadership role within the GBSG organization, reporting to the Director, Service Delivery. You will be accountable both for the day-to-day performance of a large-scale delivery network — spanning Tier 1 call center support, Tier 2 specialist support, and back-office professional services — and for evolving that network's talent, onboarding, and partner footprint to keep pace with rapid product growth. This is a build-and-scale role: Workforce Solutions is one of the company's fastest-growing product lines, and the scope of this role is expected to grow with it.
Responsibilities
Service Delivery & Operational Excellence
Own end-to-end service delivery and KPI performance (customer satisfaction, issue resolution, service quality, handle time, transfer rate) for Workforce Solutions across Tier 1 call center, Tier 2 specialist support, back-office professional services and customer onboarding.
Lead and govern a multi-partner outsourced delivery network, holding partners accountable to performance standards, contractual commitments, and a consistent performance management framework.
Directly manage an internal team of Intuit-badged workforce experts, owning their performance, development, and integration into the broader delivery model under the appropriate internal policies.
Serve as a senior escalation point for systemic delivery issues, performance interventions, and partner site risks.
Expert Onboarding
Own the end-to-end onboarding experience for new workforce experts across both internal and partner teams, driving speed-to-competency, quality-of-hire, and consistency of the customer experience from day one.
Partner with Learning & Development, Recruiting, and Workforce Management to design and continuously improve onboarding curricula, credentialing pathways, and ramp plans as the Workforce Solutions product suite expands.
Growth & Transformation
Scale the delivery footprint to keep pace with Workforce Solutions' growth trajectory, including new capabilities introduced through the GoCo acquisition and the broader shift toward an integrated, full-employee-lifecycle platform
Scope of the products and services include employee recruiting, employee onboarding, document management, compensation administration, benefits administration, performance management, retirement benefits, ancillary benefits, payroll administration and tax filing/payment processes. This role owns the customer delivery and support of the entire customer journey end to end at scale.
Partner with Workforce Management on demand and capacity planning, balancing service levels, unit economics, and an evolving talent mix across the network with a consistent focus on developing the best domain expertise based talent in the industry that customers trust.
Lead data-informed, site-level decisions on footprint, capacity, and talent domain expertise.
Develop clear, data-backed business cases to justify investment in credentialed hiring, training, and headcount, connecting service delivery outcomes to product adoption and growth.

Establish and govern a consistent performance management cadence (business reviews, performance-band reviews, calibration) across all partners and internal teams, ensuring a single standard for coaching, accountability, and underperformer action.
Partner cross-functionally with Product, Finance, Workforce Management, and Partner Management to align delivery capability with product roadmap milestones and isolate initiative-attributable performance gains amid concurrent product changes.

jobs.title: Principal Communications Manager
jobs.description:
Overview
Intuit is the global financial technology platform behind TurboTax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks, Mailchimp, and Intuit Enterprise Suite. Our mission is to power prosperity around the world, and our Global Business Solutions Group (GBSG) carries that mission for small businesses, mid-market companies, and the accountants who serve them.
We're hiring a Principal Communications Manager who is eager and equipped to help Intuit win the mid-market. This means leading creative and targeted communications efforts that establish Intuit as the go-to, industry-leading solution for mid-market companies, and the top recommendation from the accounting firms, CFOs and advisors who guide and make their software decisions. Intuit Enterprise Suite and QuickBooks Online Advanced are the products behind this push, but the mandate is bigger than either one: it's category leadership in a market Intuit intends to own by delivering a platform that meets the needs of its business customers, and the accountants that serve them, at every stage of growth so they never leave the Intuit platform. You'll have the runway to build and grow this function over time as that ambition scales.
The job is being a cross-functional leader in a highly-matrixed organization. You'll set strategy and direction across Analyst Relations and PR, including executive thought leadership and work closely to influence and engage Product Marketing, Corporate Communications, Investor Relations, and Legal, balancing the objectives of each and pulling each function's work into one coherent external story aimed at two audiences that drive mid-market purchase decisions: industry analysts and the accounting/advisory community.
Executive visibility (press interviews, bylines, LinkedIn presence, analyst briefings) is one of the tools you'll use to do that, not the mandate itself. Reporting to the VP of Brand and Product Communications, you'll own the strategy; the Principal Analyst Relations Manager reports organizationally to the VP but is led day-to-day (direction, priorities, and execution) by you. Your deep existing knowledge of the enterprise space and hungry exploration of the growing verticals we will take on as well as the changing landscape is critical and you will be the individual who helps bring that outside-in perspective to the team, by knowing what stakeholder audiences care about most.
Responsibilities
How You Will Lead
Set and own the external communications strategy for Mid-Market, combining PR and Analyst Relations, anchored in a single goal: making Intuit the recognized, go-to platform for mid-market companies and their accounting firms.
Lead the Analyst Relations strategy and direct the Principal Analyst Relations Manager's day-to-day priorities, including the analyst calendar, briefings, inquiries, narrative, and inclusion in named evaluations and market reports (Gartner, IDC, Forrester, Constellation), while that role maintains its formal reporting line to the VP.
Build and run a communications approach that reaches the accounting and advisory community specifically, the trusted recommenders mid-market companies rely on, alongside traditional press and analyst audiences.
Orchestrate across Product Marketing, Corporate Communications, Brand, Platform PR, Investor Relations, and Legal so external messaging reflects one category-leadership narrative, not disconnected product news.
Direct external PR and AR agency partners against that strategy, holding them accountable to market-position outcomes rather than activity.
Use executive visibility (press interviews, bylines, LinkedIn thought leadership, analyst briefings) as a deliberate lever to advance Intuit's standing with analysts and the accounting channel, equipping EVP/SVP spokespeople accordingly.
Represent Mid-Market Comms in planning for major company moments, including quarterly product releases, brand campaigns, and flagship events, ensuring they ladder into the larger category-leadership story.
Define and own the metrics that matter: analyst sentiment and placement, share of voice, accounting-channel visibility, and message pull-through, and adjust strategy based on what the data shows.
Build and maintain source-of-truth documentation for narrative, key messages, and editorial standards across every function that touches external communications.
Qualifications
What You'll Bring
8+ years in external communications, PR, and/or analyst relations, built in B2B SaaS, fintech, or enterprise software; mid-market or enterprise segment experience strongly preferred.
Demonstrated ability to connect communications strategy to market-position outcomes, such as category leadership, win rates, or competitive standing, not just coverage or sentiment.
Experience building communications programs aimed at a trusted-advisor or channel audience (accounting firms, VARs, consultants, or similar), in addition to traditional press and analysts.
A track record leading cross-functionally across marketing, comms, investor relations, and corporate communications; able to set direction for people and functions you don't formally manage.
Fluency in how Gartner, IDC, Forrester, and Constellation evaluate and cover vendors, with demonstrated success influencing named-vendor placement and sentiment in their research.
Experience counseling and equipping senior executives (EVP/SVP level) as one tool in a broader strategy, not as the primary scope of the role.
Experience directing external PR and/or AR agencies and holding them to a shared strategy and bar of quality.
Strong independent judgment and the ability to build and run a strategic program with minimal oversight.
Role Details
Full-time, permanent position. Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with a minimum of three days per week in office.

ServiceNow

Windows server tools

Job Description:
Job Purpose:
The Network & Network Security Lead will play a major role in ensuring the integrity, performance, and security of the organization’s networking environment. This role goes beyond operations, demanding an expert-level understanding of complex network and security architectures, a hands-on ability to troubleshoot high-impact issues, and the capability to lead cross-functional teams in delivering secure and resilient infrastructure for a regulated financial environment.
Key Responsibilities & Duties:
· Architecture & Design Leadership:
· Lead the design and evolution of enterprise network and security architecture aligned with business and compliance requirements.
· Ensure integration of network security principles in all architectural decisions.
· Collaborate with the design & architect team for the new project or new initiative
· Advanced Troubleshooting & Problem Resolution:
· Own and resolve high-severity incidents by diving deep into Layer 1–7 issues spanning networking, firewalls, routing, DNS, proxies, and cloud networking.
· Lead root cause analysis and implement long-term preventive measures.
· Multiskilling & Cross-Functional Expertise:
· Provide mentorship across routing, switching, firewalls (NGFW), load balancers, VPNs, SD-WAN, ACI, SD-Access, and network access control (NAC).
· Encourage skill development across multiple technology domains within the team.
· Security Posture & Threat Management:
· Implement and maintain network segmentation, access control, and zero-trust strategies.
· Collaborate with the cross-departmental teams on incident response and threat mitigation.
· Operations Oversight & Optimization:
· Oversee the performance, availability, and efficiency of the network and its security services.
· Develop and enforce network operations procedures, ensuring compliance with industry and regulatory standards.
· Project Leadership:
· Lead critical infrastructure projects, including migrations, upgrades, and partner connectivity.
· Coordinate cross-departmentally to ensure secure rollout of new services and systems.
· Vendor & Contract Management:
· Evaluate, select, and manage vendors and service providers.
· Ensure SLA compliance and conduct regular performance reviews.
· Compliance & Audit Readiness:
· Maintain documentation and policies to meet the requirements of financial sector audits and compliance checks (e.g., PCI-DSS, ISO 27001).
· Monitoring & Incident Detection:
· Experience with proactive monitoring for performance and threats using tools like SIEM, NMS, and flow analysis.
· Define thresholds, alerts, and escalation workflows for operational and security incidents.
· Team Development:
· Provide coaching, conduct regular performance reviews, and build development plans for team members.
· Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous learning.
· Documentation:
· Strong experience using documentation tools (Microsoft Office 365, Visio, Lucid chart).
· Ensure all documentation aligns with compliance, audit, and organization standards.
· Strong presentation skills.
Skills & Qualifications:
· Typically, 7+ years of relevant work experience in industry, with a minimum of 3 years in a similar role
· Deep hands-on expertise in enterprise networking, SDN solutions, network security, and firewall administration (Cisco, Aruba, Fortinet, Palo Alto, etc.).
· Full-stack network knowledge (routing, switching, DNS, VPN, proxies, load balancers, SD-WAN, NAC, Wi-Fi, ACI, SD-Access).
· Strong experience designing and managing secure, scalable, and high-performance networks.
· Proficient in troubleshooting complex multi-vendor, multi-layer issues under pressure.
· Understanding of secure cloud networking (Azure/AWS) and hybrid environments.
· Familiar with compliance frameworks such as Cybersecurity Framework, NCA, ISO 27001, NIST.
Education & Certifications:
· Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Network Engineering, or a related field.
· Preferred certifications:
· Cisco CCIE (DC, Enterprise, Security) preferred Enterprise.
· CISSP / CISM (a plus for security leadership)
· Cloud certifications (AWS/Azure Network Specialty)
Working Conditions:
· Based in Saudi Arabia with on-site visits to data centers and site offices.
· Availability for critical incidents and changes outside of normal working hours.
· Hybrid collaboration with global teams, regulators, and auditors.
Platform Proficiency (Required)
· SolarWinds NPM (performance monitoring), NTA (traffic analysis), NCM (configuration governance — golden baselines, drift detection, scheduled backups, rollback)
· Dynatrace with Davis AI for full-stack observability and AIOps-driven root cause analysis
· Bridge AIOps for event correlation and alert noise reduction
· ServiceNow as the system of record for all ITSM workflows (incidents, changes, CMDB, approval gates)
· Palo Alto NGFW and Cisco ASA/FTD for firewall administration

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description:
Bliv business analyst i DXC. Hos os vil du blive en del af et stærkt hold, der sammen finder løsningerne. Teamet er stærkest, når der bliver løftet i flok, også selv om vi hver især har ansvaret for bestemte opgaver og delsystemer.
DXC har ansvaret for at understøtte årsopgørelsen. Sammen sørger vi for, at beregningerne i systemerne stemmer, og har øje for de detaljer og data, der udgør grundlaget i skattelovgivningen. Vi skal sikre, at årsopgørelsen er til at forstå og bliver vist på en tilgængelig måde.
Som business analyst hos DXC skal du blandt andet:
Implementere ny lovgivning, der ligger bag slutskatten på årsopgørelsen.
Beskrive forretningens krav ned i it-systemer og deltage i test af løsningerne. Vi stikker en finger i jorden hos forretningen og analyserer os sammen frem til den bedste løsning. Vi tester systemet løbende for at sikre, at systemet fungerer optimalt og beregner korrekt.
Kortlægge processer og udarbejde procesdokumentation, som løbende vedligeholdes.
Deltage i interne og tværgående forretningsudviklingsprojekter, hvor vi fx arbejder med forenkling af skatteberegningsområdet.
Besvare henvendelser om skatteberegninger. Give bidrag til systemoptimering og lovforberedende arbejde. Nogle af spørgsmålene er ret tricky, og vi skal holde tungen lige i munden, når vi svarer.
Man skal kunne meget som business analyst, og det kan ingen fra begyndelsen. Derfor skal du som person have en stor mængde tålmodighed, nysgerrighed og være parat til at lytte aktivt.
Hvem er du?
Du er struktureret, har analytisk sans og er nysgerrig. Frem for alt er du engageret, vedholdende, selvstændig og kan få noget fra hånden – og er også en kollega, der får tingene til at glide med godt humør. Du kan have en skattemæssig forståelse, men din analytiske tilgang er den vigtigste, da vi ofte arbejder med spidsfindige skattemæssige problemstillinger.
Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund kan spænde bredt, men vi går mere op i indholdet af dine kvalifikationer og dine erfaringer end titlen på din uddannelse. Det er vigtigt at du har teknisk forståelse, uden dog nødvendigvis at være udvikler, men du formår at bygge bro mellem både kunde og kolleger, så der er en fælles forståelse. Det er vigtigt at du er omstillingsparat i forhold til kunden, kollegaer og opgaver i dagligdagen – på den måde sikrer vi at komme ”hele vejen rundt” om en given opgave eller problemstilling.
Vi forventer at du:
har erfaring som business analyst, evt. fra arbejde med et økonomisk system
har en teknisk forståelse så du kan omsætte kundens krav til et mere teknisk ”sprog”, som udviklere og testere kan arbejde videre med
at du er parat til at indgå i opgaven med test af systemløsninger
det er en klar fordel hvis du har erfaring med udarbejdelse af procesdokumentation eller kravspecifikation
gerne har erfaring med Jira, Confluence og SQL
taler og skriver flydende dansk og engelsk.
Du bliver motiveret af at finde løsninger på opgaver, også selv om de er svære at gå til og komplekse at forstå. Det er dejligt, hvis du både mestrer at bevare overblikket over opgaver og roen når det går stærkt. Og finder fornøjelse i at dykke ned i detaljer.
Har du lyst til og motiveres af at arbejde med et af Danmarks absolut mest samfundskritiske systemer, hvor du kan være med til at sikre detaljerne, så er dette job noget for dig!
Ansøgning og kontakt
Så send os dit CV – Vi afholder løbende samtaler, så søg hellere i dag end i morgen.
Der vil forud for ansættelse blive indhentet reference og straffeattest.
