jobs.title: Soft Skills Trainer – CRT
jobs.description:
Soft Skills Trainer – CRT
Description -
Job Description: Soft Skills Trainer – CRT
Location: Bangalore, India
Level: Intermediate
Function: Training Centre of Excellence (Training COE)
Program: Customer Resolution Training (CRT)
Role Overview
We are seeking a passionate and learner-focused Soft Skills Trainer to support the Customer Resolution Training (CRT) program, with a focus on strengthening customer-facing communication, service excellence, and effective resolution skills among customer support agents.
The ideal candidate will have experience delivering soft skills training in a customer service or contact centre environment and be confident in facilitating interactive learning sessions, conducting role-plays, providing individual coaching, and translating customer experience expectations into observable agent behaviours.
This is a hands-on training role that requires strong facilitation skills, a customer-first mindset, and the ability to collaborate with Training, Quality, and Operations teams to improve agent confidence, communication effectiveness, and customer resolution outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
1. CRT Soft Skills Training & Facilitation
Deliver structured soft skills training interventions aligned with CRT program objectives and customer experience expectations.
Facilitate interactive sessions on:
Customer-centric communication and active listening.
Empathy, rapport building, and acknowledging customer concerns.
Ownership, accountability, and end-to-end resolution.
Probing, questioning, and identifying customer needs.
Managing difficult conversations, objections, and escalations.
De-escalation techniques and emotional intelligence.
Clear explanations, expectation setting, and professional communication.
Positive language, call control, and effective closing.
Use role-plays, case studies, simulations, group activities, and real-world customer scenarios to reinforce learning.
Adapt facilitation methods to suit different learner profiles, experience levels, and capability gaps.
Reinforce the application of soft skills during customer interactions, rather than focusing solely on theoretical concepts.
2. Agent Coaching & Performance Improvement
Conduct individual and group coaching based on call observations, Quality feedback, assessment results, and identified skill gaps.
Review customer interaction examples to identify behavioural opportunities and recommend targeted interventions.
Provide actionable feedback on communication, empathy, listening, ownership, and resolution behaviours.
Conduct mock calls, practice conversations, and behavioural assessments to evaluate agent readiness.
Track coaching actions and conduct follow-up validations to ensure feedback is translated into improved performance.
Support agents who require additional intervention through structured improvement plans and targeted practice.
3. CRT Program Execution
Support the implementation and ongoing delivery of CRT learning interventions across relevant agent groups.
Partner with the CRT program team to understand learning objectives, customer pain points, performance trends, and priority capability gaps.
Prepare session plans, facilitator guides, participant activities, practice scenarios, and assessment materials.
Maintain training attendance, assessment results, coaching records, and program progress reports.
Ensure consistent delivery of approved content and alignment with CRT standards.
Incorporate feedback and emerging customer interaction trends into future training interventions.
4. Quality & Business Collaboration
Partner with Quality and Operations teams to identify recurring communication and customer experience gaps.
Participate in call calibrations and feedback discussions to understand performance expectations and align coaching approaches.
Analyse available quality insights, customer feedback, repeat contacts, and escalation trends to identify relevant learning needs.
Support pre- and post-training assessments to evaluate skill development and learning transfer.
Recommend targeted refreshers or coaching interventions based on observed performance gaps.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at improving customer experience and resolution effectiveness.
5. Learning Effectiveness & Reporting
Measure learning effectiveness through assessments, mock-call evaluations, facilitator observations, and post-training feedback.
Maintain accurate records of training delivery, learner progress, and follow-up coaching.
Prepare regular updates on training completion, learner performance, key behavioural gaps, and improvement opportunities.
Share insights and recommendations with the CRT program, Quality, and Operations stakeholders.
Demonstrate the impact of training through observable improvements in agent communication and customer interaction quality.
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; relevant training certifications are an advantage.
Typically 3–6 years of experience in soft skills training, customer service training, communication coaching, or learning and development.
Experience in a customer support, BPO, contact centre, or customer experience environment is preferred.
Demonstrated ability to facilitate soft skills sessions and coach customer-facing employees.
Experience with call listening, mock-call assessments, Quality feedback, or behavioural coaching is desirable.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage diverse audiences.
Proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, and standard virtual training tools.
Ability to manage multiple training activities, maintain documentation, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Core Competencies
Facilitation excellence: Creates engaging, interactive, learner-centred sessions.
Customer empathy: Demonstrates a strong understanding of customer emotions, expectations, and service recovery.
Coaching effectiveness: Provides specific, constructive, behaviour-based feedback.
Communication: Communicates with clarity, confidence, and professionalism.
Adaptability: Adjusts delivery based on learner needs and performance gaps.
Analytical thinking: Uses call observations and Quality insights to identify capability needs.
Collaboration: Works effectively with Training, Quality, and Operations teams.
Execution discipline: Manages schedules, records, assessments, and follow-up actions consistently.
Success Measures
Training delivery completion and adherence to the CRT learning plan.
Improvement in soft skills assessment and mock-call scores.
Observable improvement in empathy, active listening, probing, ownership, and expectation setting.
Reduction in recurring behavioural gaps identified through call monitoring, where applicable.
Completion and effectiveness of targeted coaching and refresher interventions.
Positive stakeholder feedback and demonstrated application of learning on the job.
What We Are Looking For
We are looking for a practical, energetic, and learner-focused trainer who can connect with frontline agents, simplify behavioural concepts, and translate them into effective customer conversations.
The right candidate will combine strong facilitation and coaching skills with an understanding of contact centre realities. They should be comfortable working closely with Quality and Operations, using real customer scenarios to address capability gaps, and contributing to measurable improvements in the CRT program.
This is an intermediate-level opportunity for a trainer who is ready to take ownership of soft skills learning delivery and grow their impact through structured coaching, stakeholder collaboration, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: IP RTL Senior Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact:
As an IP Logic Design Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in developing high-quality intellectual property (IP) for Unified Intel Chassis designs. This position is at the forefront of Intel's innovation, ensuring that our products consistently deliver world-class performance, power efficiency, and reliability. Work closely with architects to define and design complex protocol bridges. Define and implement range-based access control for secured memory and register paths across HBW and LBW. Own privilege qualification and policy propagation across AXI-Lite, APB, IOSF-SB, and HBW request paths. Design and validate parity/ECC generation and checking for request, response, and data channels. Define fault behavior for unauthorized accesses and corrupt transactions, including silent block semantics, RAZWI-style handling, poison propagation, and timeout cleanup. Build or integrate logging, interrupt, and firmware-visible error harvesting flows for local and global RAS handling. Support error injection, diagnostics, and post-silicon debug hooks for both security and reliability validation. Define and implement telemetry capture for fabric load, latency, congestion, error context, and other operational health indicators. Own debug and trace data paths for wrapper-level and fabric-level observability, including data capture, transport, formatting, and handoff to downstream debug infrastructure. Design counters, sticky status, snapshots, and firmware-visible CSRs that make performance and failure analysis practical. Integrate trigger, monitor, and logging hooks needed for bring-up, stress triage, and post-silicon correlation. Work with architecture, validation, firmware, and post-silicon teams to ensure telemetry and debug signals are useful, stable, and diagnosable. Balance observability depth against area, timing, bandwidth, and survivability constraints. Support root-cause analysis of bandwidth loss, latency outliers, protocol stalls, and intermittent field or lab issues using hardware observability features.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop logic designs, register transfer level (RTL) coding, and simulations required for IP blocks, functional units, and subsystems.
Define architecture and microarchitecture features for the IP block being designed.
Apply strategies, tools, and methods to optimize RTL design for power, performance, area, and timing targets.
Strong knowledge of AXI, AXI-Lite, APB, parity/ECC schemes, and transaction error handling.
Experience with secure MMIO, access-control/firewall logic, or privilege-based filtering.
Experience with RAS concepts such as fault containment, poison, interrupt generation, logging, and recovery-oriented design.
Support SoC customers with seamless integration and verification of IP blocks.
Telemetry and debug are both observability functions rather than primary Datapath functions.
Drive compliance with quality assurance standards to enable smooth IP handoff within the SoC development process.
Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
A minimum of 8 years of experience in logic design and RTL development.
Proficiency in hardware description languages such as Verilog, System Verilog.
Strong understanding of digital design principles, including timing analysis, power optimization, and area trade-offs.
Experience with industry-standard EDA tools for design and simulation (e.g., Synopsys, Cadence, Mentor Graphics).
Knowledge of IP block integration workflows within SoC designs.
Expertise in RAS/debug/security/telemetry.
Preferred Qualifications:
Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
10+ years of professional experience encompassing complex IP logic design for high-performance applications.
Demonstrated expertise in architecture and microarchitecture definition.
Familiarity with advanced verification methodologies such as UVM or formal verification techniques.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
A mindset for continuous learning and improvement, with an eagerness to tackle challenging, innovative design projects.
Take the next step in your career and become part of Intel's world-class engineering team, shaping the future of technology with groundbreaking innovations. Apply today to make an impact.

jobs.description:

Key Responsibilities
Design and optimize critical NAND core circuits, including row drivers, column drivers, sense amplifiers, and associated control circuitry.

Leverage scripting and automation to improve design, simulation, validation, data analysis, and overall engineering productivity.
Adopt a "Design + AI" methodology, applying AI-enabled and Agentic AI technologies to accelerate design and validation, improve productivity, and enhance engineering effectiveness.
Mentor junior design engineers and provide technical guidance to help grow the team's design capabilities.

MS with 2 years of relevant semiconductor industry experience, or BS with 4 to 6 years of relevant experience.
Strong knowledge of analog, digital, and mixed-signal circuit design.
Deep understanding of CMOS device physics, semiconductor circuit behavior, and reliability mechanisms.
Strong understanding of Flash/NAND memory architecture, cell-array functionality, and core circuit operation.

jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
Position Description
Micron Technology Inc. is a global leader in semiconductor manufacturing. The Systems Integration Group designs and manufactures internal equipment to give Micron a competitive edge in the marketplace.
Our Equipment Software Design team is looking to hire a driven embedded firmware engineer. This engineer will build embedded software running on bare metal to embedded Linux as well as higher level interface software. You will work with other software engineers and other engineering disciplines to create custom in-house semiconductor equipment from the ground up. This role requires deep understanding of hardware and system behavior to design, debug, and optimize software that directly controls custom electronic systems.
Successful candidates for this role do more than write embedded code—they can reason about how complex electronic circuits behave, use lab measurements to validate assumptions, and work side-by-side with electrical engineers to root-cause system issues. If your experience is primarily application software or firmware development without deep hardware debug, this role is likely not a fit. This role is best suited for engineers who have personally debugged real hardware in the lab; coursework exposure, only debugging to the HAL or limited schematic familiarity alone is not enough.
If you like making things work, working in a lab, and overcoming the challenges that arise from integrating multiple complex systems, you’ll enjoy this role.
Responsibilities
Design: Develop new and modify existing equipment in cross-discipline design teams (software, electrical, control, and mechanical engineers).
Code: Develop in C, C++, Bash, and Python on bare metal and under RHEL compatible Linux distros in containers.
Manufacture: Work with New Product Introduction, and Operation teams in the manufacturing of equipment.
Innovate: Our design team is challenged with projects to keep Micron competitive in the marketplace. Our designs frequently provide solutions that no one else has addressed. We design what doesn’t exist yet.
Support: work to improve existing designs, responding to manufacturing and production support.
Hands-On Work: Daily hands-on work with electronics, computers, and in-house and third-party equipment in a lab environment.
Hardware Debug: Debug software–hardware interactions using schematics, layout plots, datasheets, and lab equipment (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, DMMs, SMUs) to independently root‑cause system‑level issues.
Collaborate: Work in a cross-discipline design team with members in Boise Idaho, San Jose California, Penang Malaysia, and Hyderabad India.
Primary responsibilities
Work closely with software, electrical, mechanical, and control engineers in the design and development of next-generation memory testers
Supporting existing testers
Develop/Debug in C, C++ for embedded environments
Develop/Debug in C++ and Python for the hardware interface environment
Use of lab equipment, schematics, and layout drawings for design bring-up and testing
Communication – written, spoken, creating technical documents
Supporting globally distributed team members
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent
4+ years of embedded software development tightly coupled to custom hardware
Strong proficiency in C and C++
Demonstrated ability to read schematics and trace hardware/software interfaces during debug
Working knowledge of analog and mixed-signal circuits sufficient to understand signal paths, measurement techniques, and common failure modes
Hands-on experience using lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, DMMs, and power supplies to debug real systems
Comfortable debugging issues that span firmware, board-level electronics, and electromechanical interactions
Experience and/or interest in Agentic AI code development and including Agentic workflows into current or future processes.
Preferred Qualifications
5+ Years Experience in Embedded Software Interfacing with Hardware
Python and Bash proficiency
Proficiency in Linux and GNU tool chain
Ability to explain and debug analog front ends, ADC/DAC paths, and common noise/grounding issues
Experience programmatically interfacing with lab equipment (oscilloscopes, DMMs, SMUs)
Calibration Experience
Experience with Linux device interaction, drivers, or kernel-level debugging
Familiarity with PCIe software and hardware layers

We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Department Overview
Our IT organization has a critical role in driving extraordinary business results. Through a strong partnership with other areas of our business, we bring innovative thinking to every conversation and deliver with integrity. We’re looking for people who bring great ideas and who make our partners’ ideas better. Intellectually curious advisors (not order takers) who focus on outcomes to creatively solve business problems. People who not only embrace change, but who accelerate it.
Job Description
We are seeking a highly self-driven Sr. Business Systems Analyst - Order to Cash to support operations and transformation journeys. This role will be solution owner and bridge the gap between IT and business partners. You will oversee day-to-day operations across our current ecosystem (Oracle EBS, Subscription management, Revenue management, Oracle Fusion Cloud, CPQ, OCC) with primary focus on billing and revenue for Subscription, Services and hardware business for bundled and standalone offers. You will play a pivotal role in our strategic initiative to consolidate Order to Cash (O2C) processes into Oracle Fusion Cloud.
The ideal candidate is a strategic problem-solver who can partner with a system integrator, business and cross functional IT stakeholders for high-quality delivery, translate complex business needs into scalable IT solutions, and ensure operational excellence.
Responsibilities
Act as the primary IT solution owner for the O2C value streams with primary focus on billing and revenue.
Lead the design, architecture, and deployment phases of transformation projects, ensuring solutions align with business objectives and global standardization by partnering with SI, cross functional IT teams and business partners
Identify process bottlenecks in current state (EBS, RMCS, Oracle Fusion, CPQ, OCC) and design future-state automated solutions in billing & revenue area
Act as the primary liaison between IT and Finance operations, translating operational pain points into actionable technical roadmaps.
Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and status meetings with business stakeholders to ensure alignment and manage expectations
Proactively monitor system performance, manage incident escalations, and perform root-cause analysis for complex issues
Ensure SOX compliance, robust security, and strict audit controls are maintained across all financial platforms and during migration phases.
Strong ability to "speak the language" of Finance (accounting, Billing, Revenue, Collection) and translate it into system configurations and architecture
Basic Requirements
Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Finance or related field.
5+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle EBS, Oracle Fusion Order to Cash with expertise in Billing and Revenue and Oracle ERP integrations.
Strong interpersonal, communication, and analytical skills, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer Specialist - WAF & DevSecOps Automation
jobs.description:
Company Overview
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
Department Overview
The Core Platforms & Services team is responsible for the development and operations of critical cloud infrastructure and platform services, in support of Motorola Solutions' public and hybrid cloud-based Software as a Service (SaaS) solutions for public safety customers. This team is part of Motorola Solutions’ Software Enterprise division, which offers secure, reliable and efficient team communications, workflow and operational intelligence solutions for mission critical public safety and enterprise markets throughout the world. Our services leverage Cloud Computing infrastructure on Azure, AWS & GCP to build at scale.
Job Description
We are seeking a highly specialized Infrastructure Engineer Specialist to lead our infrastructure security efforts with a primary focus on WAF configuration management and building robust DevSecOps automation frameworks. This role is pivotal in bridging the gap between infrastructure stability and automated security policy enforcement across our hybrid cloud environments.
Basic Requirements
Key Responsibilities
1. WAF Configuration & Lifecycle Management
Advanced WAF Engineering: Lead the lifecycle of WAF solutions, moving beyond deployment to advanced configuration management, including automated rule tuning, signature lifecycle management, and high-precision threat policy optimization to minimize false positives.
Automated Policy Enforcement: Develop and maintain automated workflows for translating business requirements into WAF traffic policies. Implement CI/CD pipelines that push WAF configurations as code, ensuring consistent policy application across environments.
Optimization & Tuning: Proactively analyze WAF logs to identify and remediate complex bot traffic and sophisticated attack patterns, ensuring high availability and optimal performance.
2. DevSecOps Automation Frameworks
Security Automation Architecture: Design and deploy automated frameworks that integrate security controls directly into infrastructure provisioning. Use tools like Terraform or Ansible to enforce security baselines as part of the standard deployment lifecycle.
Security Observability: Configure SIEM forwarding and alerts for WAF and Network logs. You are responsible for detecting anomalies (like data exfiltration attempts or unusual traffic spikes), ensuring actionable intelligence is derived from system logs.
Pipeline Security Integration: Orchestrate the integration of automated security gates (SAST/SCA/Container Scanning) into CI/CD pipelines. Ensure that "Security as Code" is not just a concept, but an automated reality for all infrastructure deployments.
Policy as Code (PaC): Develop and manage automated policy engines (e.g., OPA, Sentinel) to programmatically reject non-compliant infrastructure changes before they reach production
Required Qualifications
Experience: 10+ years in Infrastructure Engineering or DevSecOps, with a significant track record in high-traffic environments.
Primary Tech Stack: Extensive experience in WAF configuration management (e.g., F5, Signal Sciences, CloudFront WAF) and Nginx/Kubernetes Ingress Controllers.
Automation Expertise: Strong proficiency in building DevSecOps automation frameworks. Expert-level skill in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and scripting (Python or Go).
Security Mindset: Deep understanding of automated threat mitigation, policy-as-code principles, and cloud-native security orchestration.
Hybrid Expertise: Proven ability to manage and automate security policies across complex hybrid or multi-cloud infrastructures (AWS, GCP, Azure).
Preferred Qualifications
Proficiency in developing custom WAF rules (iRules, ModSecurity).
Experience with GitOps workflows for infrastructure security.
Certifications: Certifications such as CKS (Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist) or advanced security automation credentials.

Operations & Backend Support: Manage backend databases (e.g., MySQL, OpenSearch), maintain platform availability, and troubleshoot complex backend issues.

This pivotal role involves driving the physical implementation of complex ASICs from RTL to GDSII, with a strong emphasis on achieving optimal performance, ultra-low power, and area (PPA) targets on the latest technology nodes. The successful candidate will be responsible for defining advanced physical design methodologies, managing and developing teams across the USA, India, and Italy, fostering innovation, and collaborating closely with cross-functional engineering groups to deliver high-quality, manufacturable silicon, ensuring first-pass success under aggressive schedules.
Strategic Leadership & Global Team Management: Define and execute the physical design roadmap, strategy, and technical direction for multiple ASIC projects, aligning with overall product and technology goals. Lead, inspire, and strategically manage a distributed team of physical design engineers across the USA, India, and Italy.
Team Development & Training: Mentor, grow, and build a high-performing global team, fostering a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Specifically, drive the training and adoption of advanced methodologies, including the introduction and implementation of Customer Owned Tooling flow to ensure efficient and robust GDSII release.
Advanced Methodology & Flow Development: Drive the development, adoption, and continuous improvement of cutting-edge physical design methodologies, flows, and best practices, particularly for advanced and latest technology nodes with a strong focus on low-power design techniques.
Project Execution & PPA Optimization: Oversee the complete physical design cycle, including floor-plan, power grid design, placement, clock tree synthesis (CTS), routing, timing closure (STA), power integrity (IR/EM), physical verification (DRC/LVS), and DFM/DFY. Ensure all physical design activities are optimized to achieve aggressive PPA targets (performance, ultra-low power, area) for complex digital and mixed-signal ASICs on leading-edge process technologies.
Cross-Functional Collaboration for First-Pass Silicon: Partner effectively and interact heavily with architecture, RTL design, DFT, CAD, package, and test teams to ensure seamless integration and successful first-pass silicon under tight development schedules. Proactively identify and resolve inter-team dependencies and technical challenges.
Vendor & IP Management: Manage relationships with EDA tool vendors and IP providers, evaluating new technologies and ensuring effective tool deployment and support.
Risk Management: Identify potential technical risks and develop mitigation strategies throughout the physical design process.
Budget & Resource Planning: Manage departmental budgets, resources, and project schedules to ensure efficient execution and delivery across global sites.

Proven track record of successfully leading multiple complex ASIC tape-outs on advanced and latest technology nodes (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 3nm and beyond), with significant experience in implementing and optimizing low-power design techniques.
Demonstrated experience in introducing and deploying new physical design methodologies, including experience with CoT flow, leading to successful GDSII release.
Strong command of industry-standard EDA tools from vendors such as Synopsys, Cadence, and Siemens EDA.

jobs.title: Contract Counsel
jobs.description:
Based in Kuala Lumpur, the Junior Legal Counsel / Contract Manager will support Nokia’s Customer Transactions team on customer-facing commercial matters across Asia Pacific, Japan and India (APJ&I), to be confirmed based on the successful candidate’s experience, qualification and language capability. Working under the supervision of experienced legal counsel, the role will provide practical, timely and commercially focused support on contracts, bids, approvals and related governance activities. The position offers regional exposure and a structured opportunity to develop contracting, negotiation, legal operations and stakeholder-management skills in a global technology business.
As part of the APJ&I Customer Transactions team, you will:
Support the review, drafting and negotiation of customer contracts and related documents, including master agreements, statements of work, amendments, non-disclosure agreements, letters of intent and memoranda of understanding.
Assist senior counsel on bids, tenders and business opportunities by reviewing customer terms, identifying legal and contractual issues, and documenting practical mitigation actions.
Prepare clear contract mark-ups, risk summaries, approval notes and briefing materials for legal and business stakeholders.
Help ensure that contractual risks and applicable legal approval triggers are accurately captured in Nokia’s deal-approval processes and systems.
Coordinate with Sales, Commercial Management, Finance, Tax, Procurement, Delivery, Product and other specialist teams to gather inputs and help progress matters efficiently.
Support contract handover and lifecycle activities, including contract summaries, obligation tracking, amendments, renewals and maintenance of complete records in contract-management systems.
Assist with contract interpretation, pre-litigation issues, customer claims and disputes, escalating complex or material matters to senior counsel.
Support flow-down of relevant customer requirements into supplier and subcontractor arrangements.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of templates, playbooks, guidance, knowledge resources and standard work processes for the regional team.
Use approved digital and AI-assisted tools for legal research, contract review, drafting and workflow management, applying appropriate judgment and confidentiality safeguards.
Deliver legal research, process and project support for other APJ&I Customer Transactions matters as assigned.
Act consistently with Nokia’s policies, approval requirements and standards of integrity, confidentiality and responsible business conduct.
What we offer
Regional exposure to customer transactions across APJ&I, tailored to your profile and language skills.
Structured supervision, practical training and access to experienced legal and commercial professionals.
Opportunities to build expertise in technology contracting, negotiation, legal operations and responsible use of AI.
A collaborative, inclusive and internationally connected working environment.
Flexible and hybrid working arrangements based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, in accordance with Nokia policy.
You have:
Qualified lawyer (or equivalent legal qualification) in Malaysia or another APJ&I jurisdiction, or a contract manager with a strong legal/commercial contracting background; eligibility to work in Malaysia.
Approximately 2–3 years’ post-qualification experience gained in a reputable law firm and/or an in-house legal or contract management team.
Sound grounding in commercial and contract law, with hands-on experience reviewing and drafting commercial agreements.
Fluent, professional-level English (written and spoken), with the ability to explain legal issues clearly and concisely to non-lawyers.
Good analytical skills and judgment, including the ability to identify material issues, distinguish legal from commercial risk and seek guidance when appropriate.
Commercially minded, responsive and able to manage competing priorities and deadlines in a regional environment.
Collaborative and confident working with stakeholders across functions, cultures and time zones.
Well organised, attentive to detail and committed to maintaining accurate records and following governance processes.
Curious, adaptable and motivated to learn about Nokia’s business, technology, customers and contracting models.
Comfortable using contract-management systems and AI-assisted legal tools, or willing to develop these capabilities.
It would be nice if you also had:
Experience in telecommunications, technology, software, cloud services, network infrastructure or another complex B2B industry.
Exposure to customer tenders, cross-border transactions or contracts spanning multiple jurisdictions.
Familiarity with intellectual property, data protection, cybersecurity, ethics and compliance, export controls or public-sector contracting issues.
Additional APJ&I language capability.
Experience with contract lifecycle management, legal operations, process improvement or knowledge management.
Professional certifications relevant to contract management (e.g. equivalent to CCCM, CFCM or similar credentials).

jobs.title: Field Application Engineer- Aerospace & Defense
jobs.description:
About Us
At Emerson Test & Measurement Business Group (Formerly known as National Instruments), we empower engineers and innovators to solve the world’s toughest engineering challenges through automated test and measurement solutions. Our platforms are widely used across Aerospace & Defense, Semiconductor, Automotive, Communications, and Industrial markets to accelerate innovation and improve engineering productivity.
We are looking for a highly motivated and technically strong Field Applications Engineer (FAE) to support and grow our Aerospace & Defense business in India.
Role Overview
The Field Applications Engineer (FAE) will play a critical role in driving technical engagement with Aerospace & Defense customers by understanding customer challenges, architecting solutions, supporting evaluations, and enabling successful deployment of automated test and validation systems.
This role requires strong technical depth, customer-facing capability, and the ability to work closely with sales teams, system integrators, partners, and customer engineering organizations. The ideal candidate is passionate about solving complex engineering problems and translating technology into measurable customer outcomes.
In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:
Engage with Aerospace & Defense customers to understand technical requirements and system-level challenges
Architect and demonstrate solutions for applications involving RF & microwave, radar, electronic warfare, avionics, communications, embedded systems, HIL, and automated validation
Support pre-sales technical activities including customer presentations, solution demonstrations, workshops, benchmarking, and proof-of-concepts
Work closely with Account Managers to drive technical wins and accelerate business growth
Collaborate with System Integrators and ecosystem partners to support scalable deployment models
Design and recommend architectures using modular instrumentation, PXI platforms, automated test software, and validation frameworks
Provide technical consultation on system integration, automation strategies, and test methodologies
Support customer onboarding, implementation guidance, and technical issue resolution
Work cross-functionally with R&D, product teams, services, and global application engineering teams
Track emerging Aerospace & Defense technology trends and customer requirements to influence future solution strategies
Who You Are:
You are a proactive, strategic problem solver who establishes last relationships and delivers exceptional results. You’re comfortable managing complex accounts and driving account growth at both tactical and strategic levels.
For This Role, You Will Need:
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering is mandatory (Electronics, Electrical, ECE, Instrumentation, Aerospace, or related disciplines preferred)
6–10 years of experience in application engineering, systems engineering, validation, or technical consulting within Aerospace & Defense or related industries
Strong technical understanding of automated test and validation systems
Experience with RF test, radar systems, avionics, embedded systems, communications, or HIL environments

Role Summary
The Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst serves as a senior member of the Cyber Threat Intelligence program and is responsible for independently collecting, analyzing, enriching, and disseminating actionable intelligence on emerging cyber threats, adversary activity, and evolving attack trends. This role transforms complex technical and strategic threat information into actionable insights that support security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, and enterprise risk decisions.
The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in cyber threat intelligence tradecraft, threat actor tracking, infrastructure analysis, and intelligence production. They operate with minimal supervision, lead complex intelligence investigations, provide authoritative threat assessments, and serve as a trusted advisor to technical teams and leadership. NXP is a global player in Semiconductor industry, and security is an essential and integral part of our business.

Monitor and assess emerging cyber threats, adversary activity, malware campaigns, and vulnerability exploitation trends.
Track threat actors and analyze their capabilities, targeting, infrastructure, and tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
Conduct technical investigations using threat intelligence, open-source intelligence (OSINT), and infrastructure analysis techniques.
Correlate intelligence from multiple sources and assess potential impact to the organization.
Lead indicator of compromise (IOC) collection, enrichment, validation, and lifecycle management activities.

Support intelligence-sharing efforts with internal stakeholders and trusted external partners.
Produce tactical, operational, and strategic intelligence products for technical and business audiences.

Experience producing tactical, operational, and strategic intelligence products for technical and executive audiences.

jobs.title: Principal Data Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Build the next generation of Oracle Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance (ZDLRA) software, helping fortune 500 enterprises protect and recover their business-critical Oracle databases. Work on software where data integrity, recoverability, cyber resilience, and performance at scale directly affect customers' most important operations.
Join our growing engineering team in Bengaluru and collaborate with experienced ZDLRA engineers in India and the US. You will contribute to shared product priorities, deliver new features and projects, and help evolve an enterprise data protection platform. This role offers the opportunity to help shape a new team while building deep product expertise within an established global engineering organization.
The work spans Oracle database kernel development and systems programming, primarily in C and PL/SQL on Linux. You will tackle engineering problems involving buffers and caches, memory management, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, concurrency, and distributed systems. Strong algorithms, thoughtful design, and an understanding of how these components interact will be central to delivering correct, efficient, and maintainable software.
You will participate throughout the development lifecycle: understanding problems, exploring the codebase, identifying root causes, designing solutions, implementing changes, writing tests, and validating results. The work combines new development and enhancements with complex defect resolution, including issues encountered in customer environments. As your product knowledge grows, you will take increasing technical ownership of assigned features and components, contributing to design decisions, code reviews, ongoing maintenance, and knowledge sharing.
We value engineers who investigate problems systematically, use documentation and diagnostic tools resourcefully, communicate clearly, and help colleagues succeed. You will use modern engineering tools, including LLMs and AI coding agents, to accelerate code exploration, development, and testing while applying independent judgment and rigorous validation to the resulting designs and code.
We welcome experienced developers with strong C, Linux, system programming skills and practical knowledge of database internals, storage, distributed systems, or other demanding enterprise software. Prior Oracle Database, RMAN, PL/SQL, or backup and recovery product experience is an advantage. Strong systems fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to translate complex requirements into reliable production software are essential.
This position is based in Bengaluru, India.
Product development and technical ownership
Design, implement, and maintain ZDLRA features and enhancements in C and PL/SQL on Linux, contributing to Oracle database kernel and systems software development.
Translate requirements and technical problems into clear designs, manageable tasks, and deliverable milestones. Evaluate alternatives and document trade-offs involving correctness, performance, scalability, compatibility, and maintainability.
Apply appropriate algorithms and data structures to build efficient, reliable software. Reason about memory use, concurrency, synchronization, and behavior under demanding workloads.
Develop and improve assigned components involving buffers, caches, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, and distributed processing, with careful attention to data integrity and recovery behavior.
Build product expertise through code exploration, technical documentation, collaboration, and delivery of fixes and enhancements. Progress toward ownership of assigned features and projects, including subsequent development, maintenance, and defect resolution.
Investigation, performance, and quality
Investigate complex defects, including issues reported from customer deployments. Reproduce failures, trace relevant code paths, establish root causes, and implement durable fixes.
Use GDB, core dumps, logs, traces, profiling tools, and Linux utilities to gather evidence and understand software behavior across interacting components.
Diagnose performance and scalability bottlenecks involving CPU, memory, storage, I/O, and networking. Establish useful measurements and validate the impact of changes against representative workloads.
Design and implement tests alongside production code. Cover functional behavior, boundary conditions, regressions, concurrency, and relevant failure and recovery scenarios using the team's engineering and test frameworks.
Use shell scripting and automation to improve diagnostic data collection, issue reproduction, testing, and other repeatable development tasks.
Follow secure coding practices and engineering standards. Evaluate error handling, resource management, backward compatibility, and versioning implications when modifying existing code or interfaces.
Engineering execution and collaboration
Take assigned work through the software development lifecycle, from analysis and design through implementation, review, testing, integration, and maintenance.
Plan work realistically, identify dependencies, and communicate progress, design decisions, risks, and blockers. Coordinate with the engineering team to deliver agreed project milestones.
Collaborate closely with ZDLRA engineers in India and the US and with relevant database engineering teams to resolve cross-component issues and deliver shared product objectives.
Participate in design and code reviews, providing constructive feedback on correctness, clarity, performance, security, test coverage, and long-term maintainability.
Write and maintain useful design notes, implementation documentation, and troubleshooting guidance. Share findings so that investigations and engineering decisions benefit the wider team.
Use internal documentation, specifications, and existing code resourcefully to understand unfamiliar areas. Ask focused questions, seek timely feedback, and help colleagues solve technical problems.
As product expertise grows, provide technical guidance, mentor colleagues, and contribute to improvements in the team's development practices and engineering quality.
AI-assisted engineering
Use LLMs and AI coding agents to accelerate code exploration, problem analysis, implementation, test development, and documentation where they are useful.
Critically review AI-generated suggestions and verify them against the actual codebase, requirements, and observed behavior. Validate changes through appropriate reviews and tests, and remain accountable for the correctness, security, performance, and maintainability of delivered software.

OCI is committed to providing the best in cloud products that meet the needs of our customers who are tackling some of the world’s biggest challenges.
We offer unique opportunities for smart, hands-on engineers with the expertise and passion to solve difficult problems in distributed highly available services and virtualized infrastructure. At every level, our engineers have a significant technical and business impact designing and building innovative new systems to power our customer’s business critical applications. Oracle's Infrastructure Cloud Object Storage team is Hiring Software Engineers, level commensurate with demonstrated achievements in the past and experience.
The object store team is responsible for a performant, scalable, highly available, and durable object store built from the ground up. We believe this team and mission sits squarely at the center of Oracle's future and is an integral part of Oracle's public cloud efforts.
We have engineering work at every layer of the stack, from REST APIs to distributed systems to file systems, and we are looking for teammates who are interested in being part of a team that innovates from top to bottom. We believe that the only way to succeed is to own every part of the problem, and so we are creating a team that controls its own destiny. You will own development of new components and features, from initial concepts through design, implementation, test, and operation.

Design, develop, and optimize Background Services (garbage collection, Object Lifecycle Management, Object Inventory, Scanner, Publisher, Snapshot Processing, etc.) to meet large-scale performance and scalability requirements.
Drive performance engineering initiatives, including profiling, benchmarking, capacity planning, and performance optimization of distributed background services.
Design and implement scalable processing pipelines capable of handling large-scale metadata, object lifecycle operations, and background workflows under metadata services umbrella.
Develop and enhance end to end tests for Background Services to improve end-to-end validation and production readiness, including scenarios that cannot be validated through traditional tests.
Build and execute performance, stress, endurance, and fault-injection tests to validate system reliability, scalability, and correctness.
Improve operational readiness by developing dashboards, telemetry, alerts, automation, runbooks, and operational tooling for production support.
Investigate and resolve complex production and performance issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement long-term fixes.
Collaborate closely with Object Storage, Dataplane and infrastructure teams to optimize end-to-end system performance and ensure seamless integration across dependent services.
Participate in operational support rotations and contribute to continuous improvements in system reliability, availability, automation, and operational excellence.

Planning & Execution
Independently plan and execute assigned projects while meeting program milestones and delivery timelines.
Balance feature development, performance optimization, operational qualification, and production readiness activities based on project priorities.
Collaboration & Partnership
Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Dataplane, Oak, Infrastructure, and SRE teams, to deliver scalable and reliable metadata service solutions.
Partner with stakeholders to define performance targets, operational readiness criteria, and feature delivery plans.
Problem Solving
Analyze complex distributed systems, identify performance bottlenecks and reliability issues, and implement scalable solutions.
Drive root cause analysis for production and test issues and contribute long-term engineering improvements.

Stay current with distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and large-scale storage technologies, applying industry best practices to metadata services.
Share technical knowledge, mentor team members, and contribute to engineering best practices.
Continuous Improvement
Continuously improve engineering processes, automation, testing frameworks, observability, and operational workflows to enhance the efficiency and reliability of Background Services.

jobs.description:
This role will require US Citizenship and a Federal Clearance
Every day at Oracle we power transformative breakthroughs in healthcare and the life sciences. HDILS products help hospitals manage populations to improve patient care and enable research and clinical trials at global scale. Our customers include leading pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and healthcare organizations including the US Government.
This position sits within HDILS Core Services and reports to the Senior Director of Program Management. Core Services is the “invisible backbone” that makes application development across the org faster, safer, and more joyful by eliminating bottlenecks and delivering foundational, reusable capabilities that no single product team should have to reinvent (e.g., security/compliance embedded in CI/CD, consistent deployment tooling, shared observability).
Core Services’ mission is to eliminate friction, amplify engineering impact, and deliver foundational capabilities that enable every team to move faster with greater consistency—while preserving developer happiness and operational excellence at scale. We operate with values such as Unblock & Accelerate, Shift Left with Care (security/compliance built into the dev lifecycle), Developer-Centric design, Reusable by Design, and Tooling-Backed Process.
As an IC4 TPM, you will partner Core Services platform engineering teams to drive planning and execution for delivery of internal platforms, tools, and reusable services that enable broader HDILS initiatives. You will also lead complex, cross-organization technical programs across a large-scale engineering organization (~1800 people) spanning the US, Canada, Europe, and India. You will drive execution across multiple products and shared platforms deployed across multiple OCI regions and realms. Focus areas include security and compliance, cost and efficiency, developer experience (DevX), and disaster recovery (DR) to accelerate platform delivery and resilience—along with major initiatives such as migrating legacy AWS regions to OCI and accelerating regional rollout in regulated US federal environments.
Key Responsibilities
End-to-end Program Leadership
Lead complex cross-org programs through the full program lifecycle: intake, planning, execution, launch/readiness, and retrospectives with measurable outcomes.
Build and maintain integrated program plans across multiple teams/workstreams (scope, milestones, dependencies, critical path, resourcing).
Establish program governance and operating rhythm (weekly execution, milestone reviews, risk reviews, executive updates), driving closure on action items and decisions.
Partner with senior ICs/architects to identify root-causes of problems and practical solutions to solve them.
Ensure every program demonstrates clear ROI (e.g., saved engineering hours, improved deployment frequency, reduced cycle time).
Shift-Left Security, Compliance, and Governance
Lead security/compliance programs that integrate controls into the development lifecycle (“shift left with care”), emphasizing automation and tooling over checklist-driven enforcement.
Partner with Oracle Health and Oracle corporate compliance teams to drive execution: milestones, remediation tracking, evidence readiness planning, audit preparedness inputs, and release gating dependencies (as applicable).
Surface and manage risk early with clear mitigation plans, owners, and timelines.
Disaster Recovery & Resilience Programs
Lead cross-org DR programs to improve platform and service resilience across multiple OCI regions/realms, including government and commercial environments.
Drive DR strategy execution and program governance: defining scope, tiering/criticality, dependencies, runbooks, and timelines aligned to business and compliance needs.
Coordinate DR readiness using measurable goals (e.g., DR test plans, RTO/RPO, test execution status, remediation closure, and operational maturity).
Cloud Platform Delivery & Migration Programs
Lead large-scale migration/modernization programs (e.g., AWS-to-OCI), including dependency mapping, cutover planning, rollback planning, and production readiness coordination.
Partner with OCI hosting and cloud operations/SRE to align environment readiness, change management, incident readiness, and operational launch criteria.
Cost, Efficiency, and Developer Experience (DevX)
Drive initiatives that measurably improve platform cost efficiency and engineering productivity: CI/CD improvements, automation, standardization, self-service tooling, and reduced lead time for change.
Define success metrics/OKRs and program dashboards/trend reporting; ensure outcomes are measurable and sustained post-launch.
Cross-Functional Release Readiness & Stakeholder Management
Drive alignment across engineering functions (development, QA, automation, performance, configuration/environment management, UX, technical writing) and cross-functional partners (product management, cloud operations, services/support readiness).
Communicate progress, tradeoffs, and decisions needed through crisp exec-ready readouts; lead escalations with options and impact analysis.
Facilitate retrospectives and continuous improvement to strengthen delivery reliability and cultural consistency.
Required Qualifications
8+ years of technical program/project management, software delivery, or related roles in a software engineering environment.
BS degree or equivalent relevant experience.
Experience leading complex technical programs in large-scale software and/or cloud platform environments, coordinating cross-org initiatives with executive visibility.
Demonstrated strength in organization, communication, negotiation, and leadership without direct authority; ability to drive adoption through influence (not mandate).
Strong execution discipline: planning, dependency management, risk/issue management, decision-making, and escalation leadership.
Track record of driving measurable improvements in cost efficiency, reliability, and developer productivity at platform scale.
Technical fluency with cloud software delivery and modern SDLC practices; experience operating in Agile environments.
Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and program planning tools such as MS Project (or equivalent); ability to produce clear plans, dashboards, and executive reporting artifacts.
Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.
Preferred Qualifications
MS degree or equivalent relevant experience.
Experience delivering programs in regulated or compliance-heavy environments (e.g., security and vulnerability management in government cloud, healthcare).
Experience building “tooling-backed process” programs (e.g., compliance automation in CI/CD, standardized release pipelines, shared observability, golden paths).
Experience with OCI and/or large-scale cloud migrations.
Experience supporting AI-enabled productivity/automation initiatives, including defining basic impact measures (time saved, cycle time improvements, adoption).

jobs.title: Revenue Analyst 3-Fin
jobs.description:
Oracle’s Global Finance Information Center (GFIC) in Bangalore is a strategic shared-services finance center supporting Oracle Finance. Within GFIC, the Accounts Receivables Center of Excellence manages global invoice-delivery operations and supports Oracle’s response to the evolving global e-invoicing and e-reporting landscape.
Job Summary
The Global E-Invoicing Business Analyst – IC3 will support the design, implementation, and rollout of e-invoicing and e-reporting capabilities across multiple countries.
This role serves as a bridge between country-specific regulatory requirements and the teams responsible for delivering scalable global solutions, including Tax, Finance, IT, Legal/Compliance, local teams, and external e-invoicing service providers.
The Business Analyst will take end-to-end ownership of assigned country requirements—from regulatory discovery and requirements definition through data mapping, testing, go-live, and stabilization—while promoting reuse of global standards and solution components.
Location: Bangalore, India
Level: IC3
Key Responsibilities
Analyze country-specific e-invoicing and e-reporting requirements, including invoice formats, mandatory data elements, validation rules, and submission, clearance, or reporting models.
Translate regulatory and business requirements into clear functional and system requirements, documenting assumptions, decisions, gaps, dependencies, and required outcomes.
Map e-invoice requirements to ERP, billing, tax, customer, vendor, and other relevant source-system data; identify gaps and coordinate their resolution.
Partner with Tax, Finance, Legal/Compliance, IT, local teams, and external service providers to support solution design, integration, and implementation.
Coordinate end-to-end country rollout activities spanning discovery, design, mapping, testing, readiness assessment, cutover, go-live, and post-go-live stabilization.
Develop and support test scenarios, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), invoice-data validation, defect resolution, and end-to-end testing across standard and exception scenarios.
Track implementation milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and open issues; provide timely stakeholder updates and escalate blockers appropriately.
Maintain standardized implementation documentation and promote reuse of global requirements, templates, mappings, and solution components while accommodating legitimate country-specific requirements.
Qualifications & Skills
Mandatory
Experience analyzing and translating business and/or regulatory requirements into functional and system requirements.
Experience with data analysis and field mapping across enterprise systems or data sources.
Experience supporting end-to-end implementations or rollouts, including requirements, testing, readiness, go-live, and stabilization activities.
Experience developing or supporting test scenarios, UAT, data validation, and defect resolution.
Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple stakeholders, including business, Finance/Tax, technology teams, local teams, and/or external providers.
Ability to manage implementation risks, dependencies, milestones, open issues, and documentation.
Strong analytical, structured problem-solving, communication, and documentation capabilities.
Good-to-Have
Prior exposure to e-invoicing and/or e-reporting implementations.
Understanding of country-specific electronic invoicing models such as submission, clearance, and reporting.
Experience working across ERP, billing, tax, customer, or vendor data environments.
Experience supporting multi-country or global implementations.
Exposure to Finance, Accounts Receivable, invoice-delivery, tax compliance, or related processes.
Experience working with external e-invoicing or technology service providers.
Self-Assessment Questions
Do I have hands-on experience translating complex business or regulatory requirements into clear functional or system requirements?
Have I performed detailed data or field mapping across multiple enterprise systems or data sources?
Have I supported an implementation through requirements, testing, readiness, go-live, and stabilization?
Am I comfortable developing test scenarios, supporting UAT, validating data, and coordinating defect resolution?
Have I successfully coordinated work across multiple business, technology, and external stakeholders while managing risks and dependencies?

What you’ll do
Security monitoring, triage, and response
Monitor and investigate alerts from SIEM, EDR, identity, email, network, and cloud security platforms.
Correlate logs and evidence to assess alert validity, severity, scope, and business impact.
Follow response playbooks; perform authorized containment and remediation; escalate complex or high-impact issues.
Maintain clear investigation records, document decisions, and provide thorough shift handoffs.
Partner with security, IT, and business teams to resolve issues and strengthen response quality.
Incident response and improvement
Support incident response through evidence collection, timeline development, scoping, containment, and recovery.
Contribute to post-incident reviews and improvements to playbooks, procedures, and operational knowledge.
Identify recurring alert patterns, workflow gaps, and automation opportunities.
Detection engineering and threat intelligence
Help develop, test, tune, and document detection rules to improve coverage and reduce false positives.
Review relevant threat intelligence and apply it to investigations and detection improvements.
Support indicator validation and guided threat-hunting activities.
Special projects
Contribute to projects such as onboarding security data sources, evaluating tools, improving reporting, and building lightweight automation.
Take on additional security operations responsibilities aligned with business needs and development goals while maintaining operational coverage.
What you’ll bring
Foundational knowledge of security operations, common attack techniques, and incident investigation.
Familiarity with Windows, Linux, networking, authentication, and enterprise or cloud services.
Experience with—or practical exposure to—security alerts, logs, and tools such as SIEM or EDR.
Strong analytical judgment and the ability to follow procedures while knowing when to escalate.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including strong documentation and cross-shift collaboration.
Willingness to work scheduled shifts, including nights, weekends, and public holidays.
Typically 1–4 years of relevant experience in security operations, incident response, IT operations, or a related field. Strong internships, labs, projects, or equivalent practical experience are also welcome.
A degree in cybersecurity, computer science, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.
Nice to have
Experience investigating phishing, malware, suspicious authentication, endpoint, or cloud security events.
Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and threat-informed investigations.
Basic scripting or query skills in Python, PowerShell, SQL, KQL, or SPL.
Exposure to SOAR platforms, detection development, or incident response exercises.
Certifications such as Security+, CySA+, or security-platform certifications. Helpful, but not required.
How you’ll grow
You will help shape a new security operations center while building hands-on investigative experience. Over time, you can take greater ownership of investigations and contribute more deeply to incident response, detection engineering, threat intelligence, and security improvement initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Security Monitoring - Security Tool Design and Development:
-Plans and performs in-depth security assessments across a variety of products and services to identify potential vulnerabilities.
-Creates testing tools to help engineering teams identify security-related weaknesses.
-Conducts security design and provides recommendations and guidance for improvement.
-Participates in reviews of security alerts.
Event Response:
-Recognizes and escalates complex security violations to senior team members.
-Follows protocols to take appropriate actions needed to contain and mitigate events.
-Contributes to post-event reviews to identify areas for improvement.
Compliance:
-Contributes to compliance assessments to identify gaps and ensure compliance with internal and external obligations.
-Reviews security compliance deliverables and ensures adherence to policies and industry standards.
-Implements measures to ensure compliance with internal and external obligations , collaborating with relevant stakeholders.
-Maintains inventory systems from a security perspective.
Business Continuity Support:
-Contributes to the development of business continuity and disaster recovery plans, processes, and procedures.
-Ensures the execution of business continuity plans to support critical organizational systems and data in the face of disruptions.
-Participates in assessing readiness for certification and/or audit to identify areas for improvement.
Data Security and Privacy:
-Provides security best judgment and recommends best practices of data security using various tools and techniques such as encryption, hashing, masking, and access management to ensure the confidentiality and integrity of sensitive information.
-Reviews documentation and procedures to identify areas for improvement in data security practices.
Research and Innovation:
-Demonstrates advanced knowledge of industry security practices and seeks opportunities to expand knowledge through self-study and training.
-Stays updated on emerging trends to stay ahead of evolving threats and vulnerabilities.
-Explores novel techniques to solve unique security problems.

Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.

Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices.

-Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members.

jobs.title: Principal Data Systems Software Engineer - SRE - Top Secret Clearance Required
jobs.description:
GoldenGate Service is a new multi-tenant, cloud native service for real-time data integration and replication in heterogeneous IT environments. GoldenGate enables users to replicate and integrate data from different sources, including operational and analytics data, as well as real-time data streaming such as Apache Kafka. This service is expected to scale across thousands of tenants and enable transactional change data capture, data replication, transformations between systems. This cost effective data replication solution is engineered for highest performance and availability to run variety of data integration uses cases of the customers. This is a global team with locations in US, Hungary, Mexico and Oracle’s India Development Centre (IDC) Bangalore.
Our team owns the reliability, availability, operational excellence, and customer experience of these services. We work closely with software development, cloud infrastructure, and customer-facing teams to ensure our services remain secure, resilient, and highly available as adoption continues to grow across commercial and sovereign cloud environments.There is a high degree of autonomy required in this role and we are looking for engineers who want to help drive our roadmap.
This role offers the opportunity to solve complex distributed systems challenges, influence service reliability at scale, and contribute to cloud services used by enterprise customers around the world.
The ideal candidate will be technically strong and get a lot done. Automation is a core tenet for everything you do. You've made life easier and have motivated your team to make both process and service improvements.
Candidates should have broad working knowledge across multiple domains, but we love to see specialization as well. The basics we expect are: Networking, Linux Systems Engineering, Software Engineering/Automation, and Distributed Systems.
Learn more about OCI GoldenGate.
Experience/Qualifications:
This position requires that the candidate selected be a US citizen and currently possess and maintain an active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility.
7+ years production engineering experience (distributed services or cloud platform experience preferred)
Proven experience with automation and strong experience in a scripting language (bash, python, etc)
Solid understanding of Software Engineering and Computer Science principles
Solid foundation in Linux Systems Engineering
Solid understanding of Networking, Security and Storage
Experience with Docker
Understanding Infrastructure as Code concept
Experience with Terraform and/or Ansible
Experience in building fully automated CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Hudson, TeamCity, etc)
Be able to understand and formulate meaningful KPIs and business metrics
Experience in building/managing/operating cloud services at one of the big cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GPC or OCI) is a big plus
What You'll Do
As a Principal Site Reliability Engineer, you will be responsible for the operational health, reliability, and continuous improvement of OCI GoldenGate and OCI Database Migration Service.
You will:
Operate and support production cloud services that power critical customer migration and data replication workloads.
Monitor service health, investigate incidents, and lead troubleshooting efforts for complex production issues.
Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews while driving corrective and preventative actions.
Act as ultimate escalation point for complex or critical issues that have not yet been documented as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Partner with software development teams to improve service architecture, reliability, scalability, and operational readiness.
Design and implement automation to reduce operational overhead and improve service efficiency.
Build and maintain observability solutions, including monitoring, alerting, logging, dashboards, and operational metrics.
Contribute to capacity planning, performance analysis, disaster recovery readiness, and service resilience initiatives.
Support services operating across Oracle Cloud commercial and sovereign cloud environments.
Leverage Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD practices to improve deployment consistency, scalability, and operational efficiency.
Drive continuous service improvement through operational reviews, reliability initiatives, and engineering best practices.
This role provides the opportunity to work on large-scale distributed systems supporting enterprise customers worldwide, helping shape the future of Oracle's cloud-native data movement platform. This role requires Professional curiosity and a desire to a develop deep understanding of services and technologies.
What We Offer
The opportunity to work on cloud services that support enterprise customers at global scale.
Exposure to complex distributed systems, cloud-native technologies, and large-scale operational challenges.
A collaborative environment where reliability, automation, and engineering excellence are core priorities.
Opportunities to influence service architecture, operational strategy, and platform evolution.
Career growth through ownership, technical leadership, and collaboration with world-class engineering teams.
Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and flexible work arrangements.

Oracle’s mission is to help people see data in new ways, discover insights, and unlock endless possibilities.
At Oracle North America Applications Consulting, we are building the bridge between Oracle’s innovative technology and the people who use it to achieve incredible things.
Our team focuses on North American based clients using our back-office cloud applications. Our resources are primarily located in North America and India. We are growing fast, and we need transformational leaders ready to bring their unique skills, energy, and creativity to help us continuously innovate how we deliver world-class client experiences on cloud applications projects.
At Oracle Consulting, we believe:
· The attributes of modern cloud businesses demand new ways of thinking: more human-centered and experienced-based approaches.
· Cloud technology should free people from bureaucracy and hierarchy and empower them to analyze and solve problems independently.
· Aligning people, processes, and technology to the overall business strategy—with empathy and creativity—transforms industries.
· Celebrating each employee’s contributions—not just their skills on paper, but who they really are—cultivates an environment where our people are engaged, believe in our vision, and are fiercely committed to creating game-changing results for our clients.
We need seasoned cloud delivery professionals who deliver world-class implementations – finding the right balance between delivery rigor and discipline and creating an exceptional customer experience. They serve as trusted technical advisor to the client via remote and on-location work.

You will possess the ability to create strategy documents for all major technical activities, using our standard templates and tools.
Client relationship management:
You'll build and maintain strong relationships with clients, understanding their needs and ensuring their satisfaction. Active listening, consensus-building, using a consultative approach to guide client decision-making, empathy and collaboration.
Communication:
You'll effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. You’ll use the appropriate level of detail according to the audience with whom you are engaging and demonstrate active listening. You’ll demonstrate confidence and executive presence when delivering presentations.
Problem-solving:
You'll be able to troubleshoot complex technical issues and find creative solutions.
Technical support:
You'll facilitate technical support to clients, serving as a liaison to the offshore technical team or product support.
Sales Pursuit Support:
You’ll conduct technical discovery sessions, work with deal teams on solution design and estimation, and participate in sales presentations showcasing our teams’ solutions, experience, and capabilities.
Drive Innovation:
You’ll contribute/lead innovation and initiatives as part of our communities of practice and cross functional teams.
Continuous improvement:
You'll identify areas for improvement in cloud solutions and processes and implement changes to enhance performance and efficiency.

Foundational understanding of OCI

Demonstrated experience in leading and delivering the above tracks
Deep experience in integration in general, demonstrated knowledge in platforms (preferably OIC), integration patterns, security, and processes
Experience in OIC, VBCS, Process Cloud, ATP
Foundational expertise in security: IDCS and security standards, SOS, SAML, OAUTH, PGP, and others.
Functional skills
Experience and clear understanding of functional concepts in SaaS modules in areas of expertise
Clear understanding of functional processes and workflows
Project management: planning, tracking scope, collecting and reporting status, identifying, communicating, and mitigating risks; effectively managing resources and identifying needs and changes.
Customer relationship building
Staying up to date:
You'll need to continuously learn about emerging cloud technologies and best practices.
Project management:
You'll drive the technical activities of cloud projects from start to finish, including planning, execution, and monitoring, ensuring they are delivered on time and within budget.
Industry expertise is highly desired.

An out-of-the-box thinker always looking for new approaches and solutions. You enjoy rolling up your sleeves and tackling challenges with a hands-on approach. You’re interested in technology, but you recognize it’s not the only factor that determines success in the cloud. You have a passion for client success across the lifecycle-building relationships that blossom into trusted partnerships one decision at a time. You know the key to delivering exceptional customer experiences lies in your ability to apply industry knowledge, providing relevant and dynamic insights to each client you serve. You’d much rather listen, ask questions, and engage in candid conversations to design innovative solutions. Entrepreneurial-minded, you have sound judgement and can navigate complexity. You are a highly collaborative team-player who can navigate different personalities, work well with others, and share lessons learned and knowledge gained from project experience. You take ownership of your individual success as well as those around you, modeling integrity and accountability with colleagues and clients.

strong leadership and management skills
outstanding communication and customer relationship management skills
deep knowledge in SaaS Applications technology and OCI/PaaS technology
solid understanding of SaaS functionality, processes, and capabilities
