jobs.title: Principal Data & Applied Scientist – Ontologies, Knowledge Graphs & AI Research
jobs.description:
Job Description
Teach AI how business actually works
AI agents are starting to take on real business work: releasing blocked invoices, re-planning supply, preparing the financial close. To do it safely, they need more than access to data. They need to know what an order, a supplier and a cost center are, how they connect, which rules and authorizations apply, and what happened the last time someone made a similar decision. When executing mission-critical business processes, an answer or action that is right 90% of the time is not good enough.
SAP systems hold the context for many of the world's largest companies. SAP's knowledge graph for SAP S/4HANA alone is based on 452,000 tables, 80,000 CDS views (semantic data models) and 7.3 million fields. Yet much of the meaning, especially in each company's own extensions, configuration and decision history, is still implicit. A 'customer' in sales, a 'business partner' in finance and an 'account' in CRM can be the same company described three ways, and an agent deciding whether to raise a credit limit has to know that. This is not a data-cleaning problem, it is a knowledge-representation problem. Today that context, the semantic layer agents rely on, is mostly modeled by hand, one company at a time. We think it can be learned, so AI agents can act on business data, not just read it. SAP's Autonomous Enterprise depends on that, and it is what makes the agents people work with in Joule Work, SAP's AI workspace, accurate enough to trust.
As Principal Data Scientist, you will define and lead our research toward that goal and work with product teams to ship the results. This is a research and modeling role, not product analytics.
SAP Research & Innovation North America
We are a team of scientists and engineers at SAP Labs in Palo Alto, minutes from Stanford. We look a few years ahead and scout emerging technologies, take the early, riskier bets that product teams can’t always take, and prove or drop them fast. SAP's product teams build and run SAP Knowledge Graph, we look beyond and find and prove methods that demonstrate improvement or paradigm shifts. Our job is to spot the opportunities that will matter most to SAP and our customers, and to get there early. We prototype with dedicated GPU compute on realistic business data and, in co-innovation projects, on real data for training and evaluating models. We publish research, work with startups, universities and institutes including Stanford HAI and UC Irvine, and hand what works to SAP's product teams. We move like a small lab, with the reach of a company whose software runs finance, supply chain and HR for many of the world's largest companies.
What you will work on
A research agenda with a point of view. Pick the two or three bets where SAP can lead in AI on business data, agree up front how we will know each one is working, and stop the ones that aren't. Closely collaborate with top universities and institutes such as Stanford HAI.
What comes next. Track emerging research, such as relational and graph foundation models, neuro-symbolic agents and context graphs, test it on SAP data before the market settles, and make the case for the next bet.
Business semantics that can be learned. New methods to learn, align and evolve ontologies and knowledge graphs of business objects, rules and actions from SAP metadata, master data, documents and process data, combining LLM-assisted ontology learning, schema matching and entity resolution with targeted expert review.
Agents grounded in business semantics. Graph-grounded retrieval; semantic parsing into SQL, SPARQL and OData calls, including finding the right API, across very large schemas; and governed actions: checks that an agent's plan respects business rules and the user's authorizations before it runs.
Models that combine structure and statistics. Graph learning and relational foundation models (such as SAP-RPT-1.6), using knowledge-graph structure to predict, explain and simulate business outcomes.
The yardstick. Benchmarks and simulation environments for agents on ERP data, where today's public benchmarks fall short, so SAP knows when AI is accurate and reliable enough to act on.
Results that land. Work directly with data teams and domain experts in co-innovation projects, turning messy enterprise data problems into tractable ontology problems, and work with the teams behind SAP Knowledge Graph, SAP Business Data Cloud and Joule, SAP's AI assistant, to ship what works.
A stronger research community. Publish at top venues, release code and benchmarks where we can, co-lead university collaborations, and mentor scientists and PhD interns.
In your first year, success could look like:
Two or three research directions you defined, agreed with leadership, at least one with a product partner and one longer-horizon
A result running in an SAP product or pilot
Papers submitted, and a benchmark or open-source release others use
Scientists doing better work because of you
This is a principal-level individual-contributor role, comparable to Staff or Principal at other Bay Area technology companies. You will drive research and set standards other teams adopt, mentor scientists who don't report to you and represent SAP's research externally, while still writing code and running experiments yourself.
Qualifications
Required
Typically 8+ years in applied research, data science or machine learning, or a PhD and 5+ years, including research you led that changed a product or platform. An MS or PhD in computer science, machine learning, statistics, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Deep expertise in one of these areas and hands-on experience in another, with at least one of the two in knowledge graphs, ontologies or semantic data integration:
Knowledge graphs, ontologies and semantic data integration: RDF, OWL, SHACL, SPARQL or property graphs; ontology and schema matching; entity resolution; semantic layers; you have made the hard modeling calls yourself (entity boundaries, inheritance, relationship semantics), not just queried existing graphs
Machine learning on relational, graph or tabular data: GNNs, relational deep learning, relational or tabular foundation models
LLM systems over structured data: retrieval, tool and API discovery, text-to-SQL and schema linking, tool-using agents, fine-tuning or post-training
Evaluation and benchmark design for AI systems
Strong foundations in machine learning and statistics; fluent in Python and SQL, with PyTorch or JAX; at ease with schemas spanning thousands of related tables.
Strong problem solving skills, shown by concrete examples: you have turned an ambiguous business question into a crisp, testable research problem, started with the simplest approach that could work, and stopped or redirected work, including your own, when the evidence said so.
Strong communication skills, shown by concrete examples: you can explain a trade-off to an executive concisely and clearly. A paper, design doc or memo of yours led a team outside your own to adopt, fund or drop something. You are able to work through a design with skeptical engineers.
Preferred
Publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, KDD, ACL/EMNLP, SIGMOD/VLDB, ISWC, WWW, or widely used open-source software, datasets or semantic standards work.
LLM-assisted ontology learning, neuro-symbolic methods, agent memory, context graphs and decision traces, or reinforcement learning for tool-using agents.
Process mining (including object-centric event data), causal inference, forecasting, or privacy-preserving and synthetic data.
Familiarity with how enterprises run (finance, supply chain, procurement, HR), and experience mentoring scientists or leading university collaborations.
SAP experience is a plus, not a requirement.

jobs.title: SAP Concur- Senior Solution Sales Executive, Nationals
jobs.description:
Job Description
You will turn customer needs into outcomes, working across teams to deliver measurable impact. Expect to innovate, collaborate, and execute strategies that drive success. Purpose To cloud revenue growth by aligning customer needs with SAP solutions, providing domain expertise, and articulating value to achieve customer outcomes. The role supports renewals and expansions, fostering long-term customer relationships and successful solution adoption. Key Responsibilities include but are not limited to Understand customer business goals and desired outcomes, aligning solutions to customer needs Partner with account owners and involved Partners to position value through solution-specific sales motions Build a healthy pipeline aligned with customer needs, leveraging Partners to drive booking, retention, and expansion Orchestrate and bring domain expertise to support key sales motions, aligning customer expectations between license sales and Partner services Articulate the expected value to customers, securing paths to future success and ensuring ongoing success to realize customer lifetime value.
What you'll bring
You are an associate-level sales professional ready to build pipeline and deliver value for small and medium-sized business in our Nationals segment in SAP Concur.
Experience in technology or software solution sales
Ability to understand customer business goals and align solutions to desired outcomes
Confidence building and managing a sales pipeline independently
Skilled at working with account owners and external partners to position value
Clear, influential communicator — able to articulate the business case for technology investment
Degree not required for this role.
Net New sales
Demand generation
Selling techniques
Competitive positioning
Negotiation skills
We also look for people who build trust naturally, communicate with clarity, keep the customer at the centre of what they do, and bring emotional intelligence and genuine problem-solving ability to the challenges they face.
In addition to the skills and experience specific to this role, all positions at SAP require candidates who are comfortable using AI tools — including agentic AI — in their day-to-day work, from crafting effective inputs and automating routine tasks, to evaluating AI-generated outputs for quality and spearheading adoption of AI practices within their teams.
What you'll build
You will own the full sales cycle for SAP Concur solutions within the SMB segment, driving cloud revenue growth by connecting customer needs to lasting outcomes.
Build and manage a self-generated pipeline of SMB or Mid-Marke opportunities
Align SAP Concur solutions to customer goals through solution-specific sales motions
Partner with account owners and ecosystem partners to drive bookings
Support renewals and expansions to grow customer lifetime value
Deliver clear business cases that articulate the value of SAP Concur to decision-makers
Orchestrate domain expertise across internal and partner teams to support key sales motions
Where you belong
You will join the Concur SMB team — the home of SAP Concur's North American operations, focused on bringing travel and expense management solutions to small and medium-sized businesses. Demand for cloud solutions is growing in this segment, and there is real opportunity to make an impact. You will work daily with account owners, solution advisors, and ecosystem partners.

Our company does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, retaliation, parental status, military service, or other non-merit factor.
Additional Information
About SAP
With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives.
As a leader in enterprise applications and business AI, SAP stands at the nexus of business and technology. For over 50 years, organizations have trusted SAP to bring out their best by uniting business-critical operations spanning finance, procurement, HR, supply chain, and customer experience.

At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

jobs.description:
Job Application for Senior Manager eCommerce at Sharp Electronics
Back to jobs
Senior Manager eCommerce
Montvale, New Jersey, United States
Apply
Overview
Sharp Electronics is seeking a strategic and hands-on Senior Manager of Ecommerce and Digital Marketing to lead the growth of our Consumer Electronics and Home Appliance business. The eCommerce Lead is responsible for accelerating Sharp’s online sales growth across its direct-to-consumer channels and retail marketplace platforms. This role drives DTC site performance, marketplace optimization, and the implementation of high-impact digital commerce initiatives that enhance conversion, profitability, and the customer experience. While working closely with the Digital Marketing and Sales teams, this role owns the transactional journey—ensuring marketing acquisition efforts and sales strategies translate into measurable online revenue growth. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and has a proven track record of scaling a DTC ecommerce landscape.
Responsibilities
DTC eCommerce Leadership
Own the strategy, performance, and P&L for Sharp’s direct-to-consumer eCommerce platform, ensuring profitable growth and a seamless customer experience.
Develop and execute sales, promotional, and merchandising strategies aligned with brand priorities and product roadmaps.
Partner with Digital Marketing to translate traffic-driving campaigns into optimized onsite engagement, balancing storytelling with sales conversion.
Lead A/B testing and funnel optimization, overseeing initiatives to improve CVR, AOV, and repeat purchase rates.
Marketplace Growth & Management
Manage Sharp’s presence and growth on retail marketplaces (Amazon, Best Buy.com Marketplace, Walmart Marketplace, etc.), focusing on assortment strategy, pricing, and content optimization.
Leverage insights, reviews, and competitive data to improve digital shelf visibility, product rankings, and conversion rates within each platform.
Collaborate with the Sales team to ensure consistent strategy between marketplaces and retail.com accounts, maintaining clarity of ownership.
Site, Experience & Merchandising Optimization
Own site merchandising strategy, including product assortment planning, navigation, onsite search optimization, and content hierarchy to improve discoverability and conversion.
Lead ongoing optimization and enhancement of Sharp’s eCommerce platforms to ensure superior UX, mobile responsiveness, performance, journey mapping and site stability.
Implement and refine new platform features, personalization capabilities, and UX improvements that drive customer engagement and revenue growth.
Manage end-to-end product catalog setup and merchandising, including technical SEO foundations and alignment with campaign execution.
Partner with Creative and Brand teams to ensure product presentation and storytelling reflect Sharp’s design and technology leadership.
Lead the digital roadmap for the eCommerce experience, including feature development, content refreshes, and integrations such as onsite search, ratings and reviews, payment solutions, and personalization tools.
Analytics, Forecasting & Operations
Establish and monitor key eCommerce metrics—including traffic, conversion rate, margin, CAC, and customer retention.
Collaborate with demand planning and operations teams to ensure accurate forecasting, inventory levels, and fulfillment performance.
Monitor and optimize key KPIs including traffic growth, engagement, add-to-cart rate, conversion, and revenue.
Develop dashboards and executive reports detailing DTC and marketplace insights with actionable recommendations.
Ensure platform compliance, data accuracy, and operational best practices across all commerce platforms.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with the Digital Marketing team on campaign timing, messaging alignment, and performance analysis without overlapping ownership of paid media or content.
Work closely with Supply Chain, Service, and IT to streamline order management and post-purchase experience.
Identify new partnerships, technologies, and innovations that elevate Sharp’s digital commerce capabilities and competitiveness.
Position Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field; MBA or equivalent experience preferred.
5+ years of experience managing DTC eCommerce and marketplace channels, ideally within consumer electronics, appliances, or premium durable goods.
Proven track record of P&L management and revenue/profit growth through paid media, CRM, and site & channel optimization.
Strong knowledge of eCommerce platforms (Big Commerce/Salesforce + subordinate plug ins), marketplace management systems, and analytics tools.
Strong analytical and project management skills with a focus on performance metrics and data-driven decision-making.
Experience managing retail marketplaces preferred.
Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.
Collaborative mindset with equal emphasis and capability to “do as well as direct”.
Continuous learner with the drive to install new initiatives and learnings to benefit the mantra of the best possible customer experience.
About Sharp Home Electronics Company of America (SHCA)
SHCA is a manufacturer, marketer, and servicer of premium home appliances. SHCA includes:
Sharp Electronics Marketing Company of America (SEMCA) in Montvale, NJ is a marketer of built-in kitchen appliances and air purifiers.
Sharp Services and Support Group (SSG) is a nationwide support operation and servicer of Sharp products for consumers and dealers.
Sharp Manufacturing Company of America (SMCA) in Memphis, TN, is a manufacturer of premium cooking products sold under the Sharp badge and more than a dozen OEM partner brands.

Comprehensive, family-friendly healthcare plans (medical, dental, vision).

Job Application for Inside Sales Representative at Sharp Electronics
Back to jobs
Inside Sales Representative
Downers Grove, Illinois, United States
Apply
Overview
The Inside Sales Representative II develops meaningful relationships with customers aiming to grow Sharp’s market share within the customer account. The role is responsible for managing assigned reseller account base within a geographic territory. Account management includes daily communication & interaction related to Sharp products & programs with key account contacts. Daily support of customer accounts includes product-related information, inventory levels, and special pricing in larger opportunities. This position requires an energetic, independent, self-starter who can manage reseller and integrator accounts within the ProAV channel. Prospecting via email and phone is a vital skill to success. Clear sales goals and objectives are defined and measured through metrics. The position requires excellent organization, computer and phone skills, and the ability to achieve sales goals. The position is not an inside support role and could be located within the US.
Responsibilities
Manage Reseller Named Accounts (20-25 accounts)
Build relationships within accounts
Grow Sharp market share within the account base
Build knowledge of customer’s organization, decision-makers, and vertical markets
Communicate inventory levels & product shipment updates to accounts
Resolve customer issues with sales, marketing, customer service, and technical support
Provide account support for other Resellers and integrators within a geographic territory
Collaborate with the Regional Account Manager team on shared territory sales strategy
Conduct outbound sales calls and email campaigns aimed at finding new sales opportunities
Drive topline revenue growth while focused on profitability
Communicate product, pricing and program announcements to accounts and territory
Create Special Pricing Requests (SPR) when appropriate
Utilize product evaluation program to further sales opportunities
Assist to resolve customer issues with sales, marketing, rebate claims, customer service, and technical support
Travel as requested to support channel events and direct reseller product/program training initiatives
Qualifications
Minimum 2 years of sales experience, within ProAV Channel preferred
Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or equivalent work experience
Proven sales, account management, and relationship-building skills
Established prospecting skills
Strong written and verbal business communication skills
Excellent organizational skills
Experience using MS Office Suite, including Teams
Ability to work in a team environment
Ability to travel up to 25%

Overview
Utilizes manual machining equipment to produce replacement and new metal parts for mechanical equipment repairs. Fabricate metal parts for experimental apparatus, prototype equipment, new production equipment, tools or dies, working from drawing, blueprints, verbal or written instructions.
Responsibilities
Under general supervision, performs a variety of tasks which requires a thorough knowledge of fabrication techniques, materials, tools and equipment.
Work from CAD data, engineering drawing, rough sketches, manuals or verbal instructions.
Operate equipment such as, but not limited to, vertical end mill, lathe, band saw, wire welder, arc welder, gas welder, cutting torch, surface grinder and CNC equipment.
Maintain work area and operate equipment according to equipment specification so as to ensure quality parts and safe operation.

Follow machine safety procedures as applicable such as rigging and lockout/ tagout.
Other duties as assigned.

jobs.description:
Job Application for Associate Director of Procurement at Sharp Electronics
Back to jobs
Associate Director of Procurement
Montvale, New Jersey, United States
Apply
Overview
The Associate Director of Procurement will lead and modernize our indirect procurement function across North America. This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for strategic sourcing, supplier partnerships, contract negotiations, spend management, procurement governance, and continuous improvement across key corporate categories.
This position will help shape procurement strategies for a global technology organization and partner closely with Finance, Accounting, IT, Internal Audit, Legal, HR, Marketing, Business Unit members and senior leadership. You will oversee major spending categories, including indirect procurement, IT procurement, travel vendors, corporate cards, purchase order activity, banking services, insurance renewals, and supplier performance.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on procurement leader who can think strategically, negotiate effectively, improve processes, strengthen controls, and build trusted relationships across the business.
Responsibilities
Lead indirect procurement strategies across North America, including sourcing, supplier selection, RFQs, price negotiation, contract review, and vendor performance management.
Partner with business leaders to identify cost savings, improve supplier quality, reduce risk, and strengthen procurement processes.
Oversee significant IT procurement activity, including RFQs, lease-versus-buy analysis, contract review, and supplier negotiations.
Manage procurement-related contract obligations and support cross-functional review with Legal, Finance, IT, and business stakeholders.
Own and improve the SAP Vendor Master process for North America, including data accuracy, compliance, and governance.
Develop and maintain procurement policies, procedures, operating controls, and best practices.
Lead travel and entertainment procurement strategy, including vendor management, corporate card oversight, employee experience, and policy compliance.
Work with Accounting and Internal Audit to review and update the Corporate T&E policy.
Track indirect spending, identify savings opportunities, and present recommendations to senior management.
Review quarterly savings goals, achievements, and procurement initiatives with leadership.
Develop short- and long-range procurement plans aligned with corporate goals.
Identify alternate suppliers and sourcing options to improve resiliency, service quality, and cost effectiveness.
Evaluate and negotiate financial services pricing, banking service agreements, insurance renewals, and related vendor contracts.
Partner with insurance brokers, HR, and senior management to evaluate coverage, limits, renewals, pricing, and risk management needs.
Support J-SOX compliance, internal controls, disaster recovery planning, and procurement-related risk mitigation.
Recommend and lead process improvement initiatives that make procurement easier, faster, more transparent, and more scalable.
Position Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Finance, Operations, or a related field. MBA preferred.
10+ years of procurement, purchasing, strategic sourcing, or supply management experience in a corporate environment.
Experience leading indirect procurement categories such as IT, professional services, travel, corporate services, financial services, insurance, facilities, or shared services.
Prior management or team leadership experience.
Strong contract negotiation, supplier management, sourcing, and cost analysis skills.
Ability to develop procurement strategies that improve operating efficiency, service quality, compliance, and financial performance.
Strong understanding of procurement controls, vendor governance, policy management, and risk management.
Experience with SAP or similar ERP/vendor master systems preferred.
Knowledge of web-based banking systems, treasury management systems, insurance policies, and corporate card programs preferred.
Strong project management skills with the ability to lead multiple initiatives across departments.
Excellent communication, leadership, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Occasional travel required, less than 5%.

jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.
Job Category
Sales
Job Details
About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
The Experience
We are seeking a visionary Principal Solution Engineer to join our IT/ITES vertical. In this high-impact role, you won't just demonstrate software; you will act as a strategic architect of digital transformation for some of the world's most innovative companies.
As a trusted technical advisor, you will bridge the gap between complex business challenges and cutting-edge technology solutions. You will be responsible for leading high-stakes engagements within the Technology and IT/ITES sectors, articulating the profound business value of our platform, and fostering a culture of continuous innovation and mentorship within the SE team.
What You'll Actually Be Doing
Strategic Technical Leadership: Lead discovery sessions and solution design workshops and demonstrations for enterprise TMT customers. You will translate "big picture" business goals into actionable technical architectures
Presales Excellence: Partner with Account Executives to navigate complex territories, respond to RFPs, and develop winning strategies for high-value business solutions.
Visionary Demonstrations: Bring the future to life through "Day in the Life" storytelling. You will design and deliver compelling proof-of-concept (PoC) solutions and demonstrations that resonate with C-suite executives.
Solution Architecture: Design end-to-end solutions leveraging [Company] products tailored to TMT-specific business processes
Industry Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the go-to expert on TMT-specific trends and use cases, including subscriber management, content monetization, network operations, and media workflows.
Team Mentorship & Growth: Coach and mentor junior Solution Engineers, sharing best practices in storytelling, technical architecture, and value-based selling to elevate the team's collective capability.
Stakeholder Engagement: Build relationships with C-level executives, IT leaders, and business stakeholders
Feedback & Innovation: Act as a critical liaison between the field and our Product/Engineering teams, providing real-world insights to influence our product roadmap and solution evolution.
Business Justification: Construct sophisticated business cases and ROI analyses to justify investment in digital transformation and cloud computing initiatives.
Thought Leadership: Contribute to industry events, webinars, blogs, and internal enablement initiatives
You're Our Person If...
15+ years of experience in Solution Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Implementation of high-value customer engagement solutions.
Architectural Fluency: A broad understanding of Cloud Computing, CRM, SFA, Marketing, and Mobile solutions.
Strong focus and experience in pre-sales or implementation is required.
Executive Presence: Exceptional presentation and storytelling skills, with a proven ability to engage and influence business and technology leaders at the highest levels.
Technical Foundations: Strong grasp of APIs, data architecture, integrations, and cloud-native platforms.
Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or equivalent professional experience.
Even Better If...
Relevant Industry experience with Technology and/or IT/ITES, exposure to Salesforce will be a plus but not mandatory
Relevant certifications (e.g., Salesforce Certified Technical Architect, AWS Solutions Architect).
What We Offer
High-Impact Work: The opportunity to shape the digital future of leading global TMT brands.
Continuous Learning: Access to industry-leading training, certification programs, and professional development.
Collaborative Culture: An inclusive, innovative environment where your voice influences product direction.
Attractive Rewards: Comprehensive compensation and benefits package tailored to top-tier talent.
Flexibility: Adaptive working arrangements to support work-life harmony.
Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
Accommodations
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
Posting Statement
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. Foster a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Work closely with Finance, Accounting, FP&A, IT, Audit, and Data Engineering leaders to align on priorities and data needs.

Description de l'entreprise
Sopra Steria, acteur majeur de la Tech en Europe, avec 51 000 collaborateurs dans près de 30 pays, est reconnu pour ses activités de conseil, de services et solutions numériques. Il aide ses clients à mener leur transformation digitale et à obtenir des bénéfices concrets et durables. Le Groupe apporte une réponse globale aux enjeux de compétitivité des grandes entreprises et organisations, en combinant une connaissance approfondie des secteurs d’activité et des technologies à une approche collaborative. Sopra Steria place l’humain au cœur de son action et s’engage auprès de ses clients à tirer le meilleur parti du numérique pour construire un avenir positif. En 2025, le Groupe a réalisé un chiffre d’affaires de 5,6 milliards d’euros.
The world is how we shape it
Description du poste
Nous accompagnons des clients issus de différents secteurs d'activité à Lyon : services publics, transport, énergie ou encore industrie.
Nous sommes en charge de créer de nouvelles solutions "from scratch", de réaliser des migrations techniques ou encore d'assurer la TMA de solutions déjà existantes.
Ces solutions concernent la gestion et le remboursement des frais de santé, la communication entre les véhicules de transport et le SI du client (géolocalisation, communication vocale, etc.), ou encore des interfaces permettant de consulter des données concernant la production et la consommation d'énergie.
Dans ce cadre, nous recrutons des profils "Lead Developer-euse" afin d'intégrer nos équipes.
En rejoignant notre entreprise, vous avez la chance de progresser à une vitesse remarquable et de manipuler des technologies (très) récentes.
Votre rôle et vos missions :
Vous remplissez les missions suivantes (non-exhaustif) :
Vous étudiez le besoin du client avec précision ;
Vous réalisez la conception technique ;
Vous affectez les tâches aux membres de l'équipe et assurez leur bonne réalisation ;
Vous apportez également une contribution technique, concernant des sujets complexes ;
Vous validez les développements réalisés par les membres de l'équipe ;
Vous assurez l'application des bonnes pratiques de développement ;
Vous réalisez le management opérationnel de plusieurs personnes : évaluation de la performance, mentorat, formation, etc.
Technologies : Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Docker, Kubernetes, Gitlab CI/CD, Azure, AWS, etc.
Qualifications
Vos compétences techniques :
Indispensable : vous avez à minima 5 ans d'expérience sur les technologies de développement employées sur nos projets : Java, Spring Boot ou encore Angular.
Souhaité : vous maîtrisez les outils d'industrialisation et / ou d'automatisation tels que Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD, etc.
Est un "+" : vous êtes en capacité de travailler dans un environnement cloud avec AWS ou Azure par exemple.
Vos compétences comportementales :
Vous savez faire preuve de détermination afin de surmonter les problèmes techniques que vous rencontrez.
Vous savez rester ouvert-e afin de découvrir de nouveaux langages de programmation, outils, etc.
Vous savez vous investir afin d'aider vos collègues à surmonter les problèmes techniques et les blocages qu'ils rencontrent, etc.
Informations supplémentaires
Les avantages à nous rejoindre :
Vous progressez à une vitesse remarquable, grâce à nos programmes de formation et à la diversité de nos missions ;
Vous trouvez toujours une personne pour vous aider, au sein de notre Communauté Tech’me UP par exemple ;
Vous évoluez au rythme de vos envies, grâce à l’accompagnement et aux conseils de nos managers ;
Vous développez votre réseau au sein de l’entreprise et créez des relations fortes, en participant notamment aux différents événements proposés.
Témoignages :
« J’ai rejoint Sopra Steria en qualité de Développeur en 2019. J’ai rapidement évolué sur un rôle de Lead Developer puis de Directeur Technique. Aujourd’hui, j’accompagne au quotidien une communauté d’environ 50 Développeurs ».
Thomas, Directeur Technique chez Sopra Steria
« J’ai un profil de reconverti, initialement de formation en Biologie, j’ai rejoint Sopra Steria en tant que Développeur en 2018. Je suis actuellement Lead Developer au sein de plusieurs projets et j’interviens également en qualité de Manager Opérationnel ».
Sofiane, Lead Developer chez Sopra Steria
Processus de recrutement :
Premier échange téléphonique avec la Team Recrutement, afin de faire connaissance et de valider les pré requis pour le poste ;
Entretien RH avec la Team Recrutement, afin d'apprendre à encore mieux se connaître et d'échanger autour de vos compétences comportementales ;
Entretien Technique avec un Expert en développement, dans le but de procéder à l'évaluation de vos compétences pour le poste.

Description du poste
Sopra Steria place la performance durable au cœur de sa stratégie et de la transformation de ses activités. Sa démarche vise à mieux comprendre et piloter ses impacts sur l’environnement, les personnes et la société, mais également les risques et opportunités que les enjeux de durabilité représentent pour l’entreprise.
Dans ce cadre, le Groupe s’appuie notamment sur une analyse de double matérialité, qui permet de poser la définition de la performance durable de Sopra Steria. Elle identifie et de hiérarchise ses principaux enjeux de durabilité selon deux perspectives complémentaires : les impacts de Sopra Steria sur les personnes, la société et l’environnement, et les effets financiers des enjeux de durabilité sur l’entreprise.
Au sein de la Direction RSE du Groupe Sopra Steria, vous contribuerez à un chantier structurant : la mise à jour approfondie de l’analyse de double matérialité du Groupe, en lien avec les différentes directions, les entités internationales et les parties prenantes internes et externes. Dans la continuité, vous pourrez contribuer à améliorer le système de pilotage de la performance durable de Sopra Steria.
Cette analyse ainsi que le système de pilotage qui en découle couvre l’ensemble des activités, opérations et géographies du Groupe et tient compte des acteurs clés de sa chaine de valeur. Elle constitue un outil central pour identifier les priorités de durabilité de Sopra Steria et alimenter le pilotage de sa performance durable.
Missions
Vous serez intégré(e) à la Direction RSE Groupe et accompagné(e) tout au long de votre stage par votre tuteur/trice. Vos principales missions seront de contribuer à :
Poser le cadre méthodologique
Contribuer aux analyses préalables : évolutions de la chaine de valeur ; cartographie des parties prenantes ; nouvelles tendances sectorielles ; recherches et études de place, tout particulièrement concernant les effets de l'IA.
Participer à l'amélioration de la méthode : mode d'implication et d'engagement des parties prenantes ; processus d'identification et d'évaluation des Impacts, Risques et Opportunités (IRO) ; critères d'évaluation des IRO.
Contribuer à la documentation de la méthodologie et des analyses réalisées : alignement avec le cadre réglementaire applicable (réglement délégué (UE) 2026/1563) en anticipation des exigences réglementaires.
La méthodologie actuelle de Sopra Steria repose notamment sur l’identification et l’évaluation des IRO, l'analyse du contexte sectoriel, la prise en compte de la chaîne de valeur et la consultation des parties prenantes.
Associer les parties prenantes à l’analyse
Préparer et contribuer à l’animation d’ateliers et d’entretiens avec différentes directions et expertises du Groupe.
Participer à la consultation de parties prenantes internes et externes afin de challenger et enrichir l’analyse.
Synthétiser les contributions recueillies et identifier les principaux enseignements à intégrer dans l’analyse.
La précédente analyse s’est notamment appuyée sur des entretiens avec des parties prenantes externes et sur les dispositifs existants d’écoute des clients, salariés, investisseurs, fournisseurs et partenaires.
Analyser et restituer les résultats
Structurer, consolider et analyser les informations qualitatives et quantitatives recueillies.
Contribuer à la formalisation des résultats de l’analyse de double matérialité et de leur représentation.
Préparer des supports de synthèse destinés aux différentes parties prenantes et instances de gouvernance du Groupe.
Contribuer plus largement aux travaux permettant de faire de l’analyse de double matérialité un outil de pilotage de la stratégie de performance durable, au-delà de l’exercice de reporting.
Qualifications
Étudiant(e) en formation supérieure Bac+5 de type école de commerce, école d’ingénieur, IEP, université ou équivalent, vous avez un intérêt marqué pour les enjeux de RSE, de développement durable et de transformation des entreprises.
Bonne compréhension des enjeux de transformation et de résilience des modèles d'affaires.
Fortes capacités d’analyse et de synthèse d'informations tant qualitatives que quantitatives.
Qualités d’organisation, rigueur et esprit d’analyse. La maitrise des principes de la gestion de projet serait un atout.
Capacité à préparer et contribuer à l’animation d’entretiens et d’ateliers avec des profils variés.
Aisance relationnelle et goût pour le travail collaboratif avec des interlocuteurs variés, dans un environnement international.
Une première connaissance de la CSRD, des ESRS ou de l’analyse de double matérialité constitue un atout certain, sans être indispensable.
Bon niveau de communication écrite et orale en français et en anglais.

Un package avantages intéressants : des titres restaurants, accès aux subventions des activités sociales & culturelles.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description
Sopra Steria offers tailored, end-to-end corporate technology and software solutions to help clients make bold choices and deliver results. Successfully so! With more than 51.000 colleagues in nearly 30 countries, we rank as Europe’s leading digital solutions provider. Some of the most successful companies in Europe rely on our technology due to our commitment to innovation, collaboration, and value in business development.
The world is how we shape it. Let’s shape it together.
Job Description
Join our Data & AI team.
You will become part of a multidisciplinary team where data engineering, architecture, AI, analytics, governance and visualization come together. Together, we help clients get more value out of their data: from setting up the right data foundations to building dashboards, analytics solutions and AI use cases that support better decisions.
As an AI Engineer, you will contribute to this by designing, building and industrializing AI solutions that solve concrete business problems and can be used in real operational environments.
You bring traditional AI and generative AI into real-world use cases by helping our clients design, build and deploy AI solutions. You work on solutions ranging from machine learning models and NLP to LLMs, semantic search, RAG solutions and conversational AI.
You train, fine-tune, improve and deploy ML and AI models. You write production-ready Python code to serve online, batch and real-time models, and you build applications and software components that make AI-driven use cases usable in practice.
You work in close collaboration with Data Scientists, MLOps Engineers, Data Engineers, AI Architects and other specialists to integrate all parts of the solution. Depending on the project, you may help build new AI solutions from the ground up or support clients in operating and improving existing solutions over a medium to long-term basis.
Within our Data & AI team, we help each other grow and keep learning from one another. Are you looking for a role where you can combine AI engineering, software development, MLOps and applied innovation? Then the Data & AI team at Sopra Steria is the right place for you.
Qualifications
We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer who combines strong AI knowledge with solid software engineering skills. You are able to move beyond experimentation and help turn AI use cases into reliable, maintainable and production-ready solutions.
You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following:
At least 4 years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, Data Scientist, MLOps Engineer, or in a similar position
Experience with traditional NLP, LLMs, and conversational AI, both in experimentation phase and in production
Experience with vector databases for semantic search and RAG solutions in a production environment.
Strong software engineering background and ability to write production ready code in Python
Experience with experiment tracking, models monitoring, LLM and NLP evaluation techniques, and deployment strategies
Comfortable with the machine learning lifecycle and MLOps and DevOps principles
Experience with at least one cloud provider and good knowledge of the data ecosystem
Able to coach others, give technical advice and direction, and work independently
Master or PhD in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Engineering, or related field
Proficient in English and you're also fluent in Dutch and/or French
What we can offer you
At Sopra Steria, you’ll join our Data Science & AI Engineering Practice within the Data & AI team: a specialized group of consultants helping clients turn AI ideas into practical, scalable and responsible solutions.
Our work goes beyond experimentation. We help organizations identify valuable AI use cases, design the right solution approach, build and industrialize AI systems, and embed them into real business and operational environments. This includes traditional AI, NLP, LLMs, generative AI, agentic AI, trustworthy AI and MLOps.
You’ll grow your expertise in AI engineering, Python development, production-ready AI, cloud and data platforms, MLOps, model evaluation and stakeholder collaboration. You’ll do this in a collaborative team where knowledge sharing, technical deep dives and coaching are part of the way we work.
As part of Sopra Steria, you’ll also benefit from strong career development opportunities, both locally and internationally, supported by the Sopra Steria Academy and a wider network of more than 51.000 professionals.
Additional Information
Are you ready to further develop your career? Then we’d love to point you in the right direction. With offices in more than 30 countries, that direction might lead you to places you’ve never been to before. Would you prefer to grow internally? That’s possible, too. We challenge you to keep pushing yourself to become the best you can be.
We offer a generous employee benefits package that includes:
A variety of perks, such as mobility options (including a company car), insurance coverage, meal vouchers, eco-cheques, and more.
Continuous learning opportunities through the Sopra Steria Academy to support your career development.
The opportunity to connect with fellow Sopra Steria colleagues at various team events.
Ready to take the next step?
We’re here to support you all the way and we are looking forward to your application!

jobs.description:
Resumes/CVs must be submitted in English, your application will not be considered if in another language.
We are seeking a Senior Business Process Analyst to join Service Solutions Europe (SSE), who are Sony’s aftersales function for both Consumer and Professional Products.
